rows.title: Software Engineer - Data & AI
rows.descriptionText:
What to Expect

Working within the Data & AI capability team, this role designs, builds, and operates full-stack, AI-enabled software, with a strong frontend focus. You build the user-facing products and interfaces that make McLaren's data and AI usable: chat experiences, engineering assistants, dashboards, and internal digital products, backed by the AI platforms.

You will work in a product-oriented delivery model, embedded in or allocated to a business-aligned product team (Product Development, Manufacturing, or Commercial), drawing on shared capabilities from the unified platform team.

You sit at a valuable intersection where you build both the polished front-end users interact with and the AI integration layer behind it (streaming LLM responses, RAG, agents), deploying on the cloud infrastructure that runs them.

What You'll Do

Design, build, and maintain responsive, accessible, high-performance web applications and AI-enabled interfaces, including chat UIs, streaming responses, dashboards, and interactive tools.Build AI-enabled UX that is transparent and trustworthy: token-by-token streaming, source citations, confidence indicators, human-in-the-loop review and correction, safety warnings, and graceful error/fallback states.Integrate frontends with the McLaren AI platforms, handle streaming, token limits, rate limits, and retries.Build and maintain backend services and APIs that support AI-powered features and connect to data products and source systems.Deliver data and AI products through the lifecycle, from POC and proof of integration (POI) to MVP and production, connecting cleanly to source systems and downstream consumers at every integration boundary.Own the infrastructure your services run on: infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, containerisation, and observability and deployment.Contribute to AI evaluation and quality: build and run automated evals and regression tests and use observability tooling to track latency, token usage, and failure modes.Apply governance and security as code: ownership, access controls, lineage, quality checks, auth, least privilege, and encryption, scaled by product maturity.Champion McLaren-controlled infrastructure and data residency by default and drive adoption of AI tools.Plan and deliver work in agile sprints, balancing exploratory R&D with production-grade delivery. Give honest estimates and flag scope risk early.

What You'll Bring

Python (FastAPI), Node.js, REST APIs.SQL and PostgreSQL.Redis/Valkey for session and WebSocket coordination at scale.Strong JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSSReact (or equivalent), component architecture, state management.Responsive design, web performance (Core Web Vitals: LCP/INP/CLS).Git-based workflows and CI/CDPHP, MS SQL Server, Matlab, for transitional support and migration only.Rust for performance-critical components.Fine-tuning (LoRA/PEFT), multimodal models. Familiarity with the AWS GenAI-on-EKS pattern (LiteLLM + vector DB + Langfuse via Terraform/Helm) Data visualisation; design-tool literacy (Figma). 

What We'll Do for You

We offer a wide – ranging benefits package, which includes:

Structured career development framework25 days’ holiday, plus bank holiday. Annual buy & sell up to five daysEnhanced company pension schemeDiscretionary annual bonus awardPrivate medical insurance and health cash planLife assurance benefitAbility to apply for a sabbatical of up to one year after only two years’ serviceBenefits you can adapt to your lifestyle, such as discounted shoppingGenerous parental leave policiesA range of wellbeing initiatives, such as employee assistance programme and free financial & mortgage advice

Who Are We?

No restraints. No limitations. We don’t simply push boundaries. We completely rethink them. McLaren Automotive exists to create breath-taking performance road cars.

It takes a community to do what we do. A diverse group of people with many areas of expertise, united by their passion to deliver visionary products and set new benchmarks.

McLaren Automotive commits to equal opportunity for all. Diversity, Equality and Inclusion is at the heart of our impact, it drives our innovation and enables us to truly create something special. Join us on our journey.

rows.title: Forward Deployed AI Developer - Senior Associate - UK Wide
rows.descriptionText:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Forward Deployed AI Developer - Senior Associate 

Location - any UK office

Job Overview

We are seeking a talented and passionate Forward Deployed AI Developer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in applied artificial intelligence, agent development and software engineering. You will work as part of a team that designs, develops and implements AI agents and automation tools that drive innovation and change the way our business works.

Key Responsibilities

Help with the design of, and develop, AI agents and automation tools to solve complex problems and improve business processes.Be part of a team that collaborates with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.Build and orchestrate LLM agents, including prompt design, grounding and retrieval, and structured outputs.Test and evaluate agent behaviour, including handling uncertainty and non-deterministic outputs.Build and configure solutions across the Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages and Dataverse, together with solution management, environments and application lifecycle management.Integrate AI tools with enterprise systems through APIs, including Graph, REST, SQL, SharePoint and dedicated business systems.Develop cloud native skills on platforms such as Azure and AWS, and understand the AI offerings within them.Work on projects through the full delivery lifecycle, supporting the design, through development and build, testing, and into production.Support live products and triage defects with real users.Work within enterprise guardrails, including AI risk assessment, information security review, data loss prevention, environments and licensing.Conduct data analysis and preparation to support the development and evaluation of AI solutions.Stay up to date with the latest advancements in AI and apply them to projects.Document code, processes and methodologies to ensure maintainability and knowledge sharing within the team.Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers.

Required Skills And Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.Proven experience as an AI developer or in a similar role, with a portfolio of projects.Proficiency in programming languages such as Python and TypeScript.Working knowledge of Git and version control.Good understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software design principles.Familiarity with data manipulation and analysis tools such as Pandas, NumPy, and SQL.Experience with, or a strong willingness to develop skills in, the Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages and Dataverse.Basic understanding of cloud computing and of SaaS, PaaS and IaaS.Knowledge of cloud platforms and their AI services.Good problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and in a team environment.Strong communication skills to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Copilot Studio, or another agent orchestration platform.Experience of taking a product through enterprise governance, such as AI risk assessment, information security review and data loss prevention.Front end, user experience or product design exposure that signals an awareness of user considerations.Knowledge of containerisation technologies like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes.

What We Offer

Opportunities for professional growth and development.A collaborative and innovative work environment.The chance to work on cutting-edge AI projects that make a difference.

What Working At EY Offers

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues aroundOpportunities to develop new skills and progress your careerThe freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance. 

#AIEY

EY | Building a better working world 

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

rows.title: AI Tech Support Engineer (UK)
rows.descriptionText:
About Nexus Black

Nexus Black is an AI-first business within IFS, built to move quickly, challenge traditional ways of working, and turn the potential of AI into real-world outcomes for enterprise customers. We build AI to solve hard problems for the industries that keep the world turning: up on power lines, down on factory floors, and out in the field.

Our products — Resolve (field service and predictive maintenance), Flow (production planning), Comply (regulatory compliance) and Reason (analytical reasoning) — are used by technicians and engineers who cannot afford a tool that doesn't work first time. We pair 40 years of IFS industrial depth with the technical pace of a start-up, and we get results in weeks, not months.

We're building a team of highly capable, high-ownership people who are comfortable operating across traditional boundaries. We care less about rigid job descriptions and more about people who can understand a problem, get hands-on, and own the outcome.

The Role

As an IT Support Engineer at Nexus Black, you ensure every engineer’s essential tools laptops, communication, development, and AI accounts are fully provisioned, secured, and ready to go before they start. You will own the identity infrastructure, manage the Microsoft 365 and SaaS estate, and handle endpoint support across a rapidly growing organization. The environment is built on Entra ID, supported by industry-leading SaaS tools and ongoing cross-tenant migrations.

This is not a traditional helpdesk role. You are the driving force behind automation, continuously building processes that reduce repetitive tasks. You’ll identify the right licence tiers, anticipate integration needs, and script migrations, never settling for manual steps where automation is possible.

What We’re Looking For

AI-First Problem Solver: You instinctively reach for AI solutions—Claude Code, Graph API scripts, or automation—whenever you spot repetitive work. Automation-Minded Operator: You maximize efficiency, valuing hours saved by automation over tickets closed. 

Responsibilities

Identity & Access

Design and manage Microsoft Entra ID at tenant scale, including SSO (SAML/OIDC), MFA, Conditional Access, SCIM provisioning, and full lifecycle automation. Oversee cross-tenant identity mapping and B2B collaboration for acquired teams and partner organizations. Manage secrets and credential rotation in 1Password Business and Azure Key Vault. Routinely conduct access reviews and maintain audit logs. 

Microsoft 365 & Collaboration

Administer the M365 environment: Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams. Lead cross-tenant migrations via Microsoft Migration Orchestrator and tools (ShareGate, AvePoint, BitTitan, Quest). Maintain Slack and Notion at the Business/Enterprise tier. 

SaaS Administration

Hold admin ownership of the SaaS estate: GitHub Enterprise, Figma Organization, HubSpot, Cursor, Claude Team/Enterprise, Coralogix, LangSmith, FullStory, Vanta, Vercel, Railway, Supabase, Clerk. Evaluate and understand licence tiers, ensuring SSO, SCIM, and logging capabilities are ready before procurement. 

Endpoints & Devices

Manage endpoint policy and MDM with Intune, Jamf, or Kandji (Mac). Oversee device procurement, imaging, and BYOD policy. 

Automation & Scripting

Develop PowerShell, Python, or TypeScript scripts to automate manual operations. Integrate with Microsoft Graph API and various vendor APIs (Slack, Notion, GitHub, Figma). Use Claude Code or equivalent tools to build migration scripts and internal automations as part of your standard workflow. 

Apple Developer Account

Manage Apple Developer and App Store Connect (enrolment, D-U-N-S, certificates, provisioning, TestFlight, custom app distribution). 

What Else You Bring

Strong negotiation skills for dealing with vendors and partners. Exceptional written communication—you can independently run a migration plan and keep everyone aligned without needing constant oversight. 

Nice To Have (But Not Required On Day One)

Experience with Azure (subscriptions, RBAC, billing) and AWS Organizations. Familiarity with VPN, firewall, and DNS in customer environments. Knowledge of ISO 27001 or SOC 2 controls and audit processes. Incident response basics. 

If you’re ready to harness automation and AI to transform IT support, we’d love to meet you.

rows.title: Data Validation Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.

The Role

We are looking for a Data Validation Specialist to join our team and support the data conversion for new Addepar clients. This role involves cross-referencing large sets of financial data between spreadsheets and systems, helping to ensure accuracy during onboarding. You’ll play a key part in identifying and tracking any inconsistencies, with clear documentation and attention to detail being the most important parts of the job.

This is primarily a non-client-facing role that plays a key part behind the scenes, requiring focus, consistency, and comfort with repetitive work. It’s a great fit for someone who enjoys working with data in a structured way and takes pride in getting the details right.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

Dive Deep into Data: Review and compare client data across spreadsheets and platforms to identify inconsistencies or gaps Document and Log: Thoroughly document and log all your findings in a clear, standardized formatCollaborate: Work closely with Project Leads who will guide your research and analysis and act as the main point of contact for our clientsManage Multiple Projects: Prioritize and context-switch effectively to complete simultaneous projects; seeing each through to the finish lineIdentify and implement AI-driven automation and LLM integrations to streamline implementation

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, ideally in Business, Finance, Math, Economics, or another data-oriented field1+ year(s) of experience in a structured, detail-focused role such as data entry, financial operations, or data quality assuranceStrong organizational skills with a focus on accuracy and consistencyAbility to work independently and as part of a collaborative team environmentProficiency with spreadsheets (e.g., Excel), internal tools, and web-based platformsFamiliarity with financial data is a plus, but not required. Quick to learn new systems and follow structured processes for data navigation and validationEffective time management skills and the ability to balance multiple priorities

Our Values 

Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

Alts Data Operations is an Addepar team that focuses on Alternatives Investment Data. The team collects and validates information on private funds, private companies and other non-public investments. The R&I mission is to inform wealth managers and institutional investors on new ways to improve their investment performance, by helping them augment their governance, management, operations, and processes. The goal is to apply Addepar’s proprietary and private data (both quantitative and qualitative) to bring new and powerful insights to the world of investors.

We are currently seeking an Alternatives Data Operations Analyst to work UK hours, joining our growing presence in Pune. This role will be dedicated to capturing and updating Alternatives data to power new innovations developed using a proprietary research platform. The platform aggregates over $9 Trillion in assets into an analytical data store that can be analyzed for new insights by researchers at Addepar and other prominent research institutions (e.g. London School of Economics, Dept. of Finance). This data is used for our research projects on investment decision-making and deliver new research products on topics related to investing (e.g., briefs, working papers, journal articles, models). The R&I mission is to inform wealth managers and institutional investors on new ways to improve their investment performance, by helping them augment their governance, management, operations, and processes. The goal is to apply Addepar’s proprietary and private data (both quantitative and qualitative) to bring new and powerful insights to the world of investors.

We are currently seeking an Alternatives Data Operations Analyst to work UK hours, joining our growing presence in Pune. This role will be dedicated to capturing and updating Alternatives data to power new innovations developed using a proprietary research platform. The platform aggregates over $9 Trillion in assets into an analytical data store that can be analyzed for new insights by researchers at Addepar and other prominent research institutions (e.g. London School of Economics, Dept. of Finance). The role is responsible for ensuring the platform has timely and high-quality data available. This will include oversight of the alternatives security master, data quality validations management, and workflow oversight.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

Work collaboratively with our UK team investigating Alternative Investment attributes during the UK working hoursResearch investments on Addepar’s global database and classify per asset type, vintage, and strategy. Oversee and manage operational workflows for Alternative data processingDevelop and maintain effective process controls and accurate metrics to ensure quality standardsPartner with members of the Research team to implement and run data quality validationsOversee the security master and security classification processes Own and Optimise Data Pipelines: Independently manage and troubleshoot complex end-to-end data ingestion pipelines, resolving technical blockers (e.g., networking, querying, or database errors) in partnership with engineering teams.Integrate AI & Developer Tooling: Proactively explore and implement AI-assisted developer tools (such as Claude Code or custom LLM prompts) to optimise repetitive workflows, streamline document parsing, and shorten validation cycles.

Who You Are

Prior experience of financial investment/advisory industry with knowledge of capital markets, middle/back-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw-down) Funds reporting statements and data. Detailed in documenting and exhibits good follow-through techniques Track record of effective problem-solving abilities, self-motivation to take on responsibility, and a strong team-player mentalityOutstanding communication and interpersonal skills for working with clients, custodial data providers, as well as internal working partnersTechnical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Python (Jupyter Notebook, Pandas, PySpark, etc.), Databricks, Bloomberg, Pitchbook, or other common financial services systems and applicationsHands-on SQL & Data Warehouse Experience: Strong proficiency using SQL and Databricks (PySpark) to navigate complex data architectures, extract custom audits, and validate high-volume datasets.Familiarity with Modern AI Developer Tools: Exposure to or a strong interest in using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or automated API integrations) to optimize code and speed up daily data operational workflows.Alternative Asset Document Literacy: Exceptional ability to interpret unstructured private market financial data (such as Form D filings, capital account statements, or institutional investment briefs) and translate them into clean, structured database taxonomies.

Our Values 

Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

VAS Regional Growth Marketing is Visa's in-market growth engine for Value-Added Services — the function that translates regional business priorities into marketing action. We partner directly with sales, GTM, and regional product teams to identify growth opportunities, remove adoption barriers, and orchestrate the right marketing channels at the right moments. We are a global team embedded across five regions: AP, CEMEA, EUR, LAC, and NA. This is not an events coordination role. It is an entry point into strategic B2B growth marketing at one of the world's most recognized brands.

The Analyst, Regional Growth Marketing will support the execution and measurement of field marketing programs for Visa's Value-Added Services portfolio — spanning Issuing Solutions, Risk and Identity, and Acceptance — within their assigned region. Reporting to the Regional Growth Marketing Director or Senior Marketing Manager, this role is designed for an analytically sharp, commercially curious marketing professional who wants to build expertise at the intersection of B2B strategy, demand generation, and financial services.

This role is responsible for budget management, commercial performance analysis, pipeline visibility, install base insights, partner marketing and executive reporting that enable informed business decisions and growth investments. The successful candidate will partner closely with Marketing, Sales, GTM, Finance, Operations, and external partners to translate data into actionable recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness, resource allocation, and business outcomes.

initiatives, and partner programsPartner with Sales, GTM, Finance, Operations, and Marketing teams to align priorities and reporting.Conduct install base, customer, segment, and whitespace analysis to communications.

rows.title: Applied Researcher I
rows.descriptionText:
Overview:

At Capital One, we are creating trustworthy and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description:

The AI Foundations team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our work touches every aspect of the research life cycle, from partnering with Academia to building production systems. We work with product, technology and business leaders to apply the state of the art in AI to our business.

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how customers interact with their money. Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, Lightning, VectorDBs, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data. Build AI foundation models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation. Engage in high impact applied research to take the latest AI developments and push them into the next generation of customer experiences. Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals. 

The Ideal Candidate:

You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing AI foundation models and solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Has a deep understanding of the foundations of AI methodologies. Experience building large deep learning models, whether on language, images, events, or graphs, as well as expertise in one or more of the following: training optimization, self-supervised learning, robustness, explainability, RLHF. An engineering mindset as shown by a track record of delivering models at scale both in terms of training data and inference volumes. Experience in delivering libraries, platform level code or solution level code to existing products. A professional with a track record of coming up with high quality ideas or improving upon existing ideas in machine learning, demonstrated by accomplishments such as first author publications or projects. Possess the ability to own and pursue a research agenda, including choosing impactful research problems and autonomously carrying out long-running projects. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, AI, Mathematics, or related fields, with an exception that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, AI, Mathematics, or related fields plus 2 years of experience in Applied Research

Optimization (Training & Inference)PhD focused on topics related to optimizing training of very large deep learning models Multiple years of experience and/or publications on one of the following topics: Model Sparsification, Quantization, Training Parallelism/Partitioning Design, Gradient Checkpointing, Model Compression Experience optimizing training for a 10B+ model Deep knowledge of deep learning algorithmic and/or optimizer design Experience with compiler designFinetuningPhD focused on topics related to guiding LLMs with further tasks (Supervised Finetuning, Instruction-Tuning, Dialogue-Finetuning, Parameter Tuning) Demonstrated knowledge of principles of transfer learning, model adaptation and model guidanceExperience deploying a fine-tuned large language model

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Overview

Job Description

Join Visa Treasury's Digital Assets and Innovation team to help reshape how money moves with digital assets like stablecoins and next-gen payment rails. In this role, you'll own operations end to end, develop treasury roadmaps, and guide decisions, partnering with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Settlement Ops, Finance, and Product to vet ideas and design and launch pilots with external partners. You'll keep a close pulse on the crypto ecosystem and turn research into clear recommendations. We're looking for someone who brings big ideas and takes ownership, yet stays grounded in treasury fundamentals like liquidity, settlement, reconciliation, and controls. This role is perfect if you're ready to roll up your sleeves, move fast, and help define the next chapter of money movement at Visa.

Key Responsibilities

Run daily treasury operations across digital assets and traditional payments, including cash, liquidity, settlement, and reconciliation.Execute treasury activities across blockchains, custodians, wallets, banks, exchanges, and payment providers.Participate in a rotating weekend and after-hours support model for critical treasury operations and incident response.Monitor fiat and digital asset liquidity, funding needs, and operational risk controls.Support stablecoin operations, including minting, redemption, custody transfers, wallet funding, and exception management.Own settlement, reconciliation, operational controls, audit readiness, and issue resolution processes.Improve runbooks, procedures, controls, and escalation frameworks.Track KPIs and operational metrics; provide actionable insights to leadership.Assess opportunities and risks across digital asset use cases, focusing on liquidity, efficiency, settlement, and working capital impacts.Monitor developments across blockchain, stablecoin, custody, payments, and regulatory ecosystems.Create executive-ready presentations, strategy memos, and business recommendations.Lead pilot execution from planning through launch, including governance, testing, vendor diligence, and operational readiness.Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to build scalable solutions.Support selection and evaluation of custody, wallet, banking, payment, and blockchain infrastructure providers.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

2 or more years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree or an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD, or PhD)

rows.title: Business Systems Analyst - Patent Office
rows.descriptionText:
Your opportunity

At Schwab, you’re empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us “challenge the status quo” and transform the finance industry together.

We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site in the specified location(s).

The Intellectual Property Data Analyst will turn patent and technology data into actionable intelligence that supports Schwab’s innovation and intellectual property objectives. This role focuses on business and patent analytics for portfolio benchmarking, technology landscape assessments, whitespace and trend analysis and competitive intelligence and develop dashboards and leadership-ready insights to support Schwab’s Intellectual Property strategy. The Analyst will provide intelligence that helps inform where Schwab should build, partner, or further evaluate opportunities while improving the analytical foundation for patent portfolio decisions and executive reporting.

Key Responsibilities

Evaluate patent portfolios for trends, growth, quality, technology coverage, and overall portfolio health.Develop metrics and insights that support Schwab’s portfolio decisions.Monitor competitors, technology trends, and patent activity across key priority domains.Identify opportunities, risks, emerging technologies, and innovation trends that may impact the company.Create dashboards, presentations, and recurring reports that summarize portfolio activity, technology trends, and competitive developments that present complex information in a clear and actionable manner.Partner with the Schwab Patent Office Director and business or technology teams to coordinate targeted invention-harvesting sessions.Review innovation themes, project information, and technology initiatives to help identify areas where patent, trade secret, or other innovation-protection approaches may warrant further evaluation .Monitor external developments relevant to patent, trade secret, and innovation protection strategies.Assist with preparing materials for invention workshops, Patent Forums, and innovation discussions.Maintain data quality and research resources.Collect, validate, and organize data from patent databases and other research sources.Maintain consistent reporting standards, research methods, and supporting documentation.

Success Measures

Patent portfolio, competitive intelligence, and technology landscape analyses produce clear insights that inform filing priorities, protection strategy, and leadership decisions.Dashboards, visualizations, and recurring reports are accurate, timely, easy to interpret, and tailored to Legal, Technology, and executive audiences.Competitive monitoring identifies meaningful technology trends, whitespace opportunities, portfolio risks, and emerging innovation areas relevant to Schwab.Innovation-harvesting support helps Patent Office leadership and technology teams focus discussions on areas with strong protection potential.Research methods, data sources, and reporting standards are documented, repeatable, and continuously improved for quality and consistency.

What you have

Minimum Qualifications

Experience in patent analytics, competitive intelligence, portfolio analysis, technology research, business intelligence, or related analytical discipline.Ability to analyze complex datasets, identify trends and gaps, validate findings, and translate results into concise recommendations for technical, legal, and executive audiences.Strong proficiency with Excel and PowerPoint, including data visualization, dashboard development, and leadership-ready storytelling.Demonstrated research discipline, attention to data quality, and ability to manage recurring monitoring and ad hoc analysis across multiple technology domains.Strong collaboration and facilitation skills, including the ability to work with inventors, technical leaders, Legal, and Schwab Patent Office stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Registration in good standing as a patent agent with the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office.Experience with patent databases or analytics platforms such as LexisNexis PatentSight+, PatSnap, Derwent, Innography, or comparable tools.Experience creating process automation tools.Experience supporting invention-harvesting, innovation strategy, market intelligence, or process automation.

In addition to the salary range, this role is also eligible for bonus or incentive opportunities.

What’s in it for you

At Schwab, you’re empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. rows.title: Trade Compliance Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Title: Trade Compliance AnalystLocation: Sunnyvale, CADuration: 06+ Months Shift & Timing: Regular Business Hours Pay Range: $53.14 /Hour on W2
Job Description:We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Trade Compliance Analyst to support our Global Trade Compliance program. This role is responsible for conducting, reviewing, tracking, and documenting critical day-to-day compliance activities, including restricted party screening, sanctions and due diligence research, transaction analysis, compliance documentation, and program recordkeeping.The successful candidate will serve as a key operational partner within the compliance function, helping ensure that transactions, business relationships, and third-party engagements comply with applicable export control, sanctions, and trade regulations. The role will also support the compliance team’s organizational and recordkeeping needs while identifying opportunities to track and produce KPIs, reports, and dashboards.This position is ideal for an individual who thrives in a data-intensive environment, conducts deep research, follows precise protocols, and demonstrates exceptional accuracy and attention to detail.
Key ResponsibilitiesRestricted Party Screening & Due DiligenceReview and adjudicate restricted party screening alerts generated through automated and manual screening processes.Conduct research on companies, individuals, ownership structures, corporate affiliations, and business relationships to support screening determinations.Perform enhanced due diligence reviews on suppliers, customers, distributors, freight forwarders, research institutions, and other third parties.Prepare clear, concise, and well-supported written analyses documenting screening outcomes and recommendations.
Data Analysis & Compliance MonitoringAnalyze large data sets to identify trends, anomalies, and potential trade compliance risks.Support periodic compliance reviews of transactions, customer populations, third-party relationships, and business activities.Validate and reconcile compliance-related data across multiple systems and databases.Develop reports and metrics to support monitoring of compliance program effectiveness.Assist with dashboard development, reporting automation, and data quality initiatives.
Research & InvestigationsConduct detailed research into corporate ownership structures, beneficial ownership, and complex business relationships.Validate customer, supplier, and third-party information using public and commercial research tools.Support investigations involving unusual transactions, high-risk jurisdictions, sensitive end uses, or complex routing scenarios.Perform deep-dive research to resolve identity verification and ownership questions.Summarize findings and provide risk-based recommendations to business stakeholders and compliance leadership.
Compliance Documentation & RecordkeepingEnsure external business partners adhere to implemented compliance requirements, including timely and accurate submission of Proofs of Delivery, End User Statements, and other required documentation.Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready compliance records in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements.Organize and manage screening documentation, due diligence files, approvals, classifications, and supporting evidence.Support internal audits, external audits, compliance reviews, and regulatory inquiries.Ensure compliance records are properly indexed, retained, and readily retrievable.Contribute to continuous improvement of documentation processes and recordkeeping standards.
Program Support & Process ImprovementAssist in maintaining compliance procedures, work instructions, and training materials.Support implementation of compliance tools, workflows, and process improvements.Participate in special projects related to sanctions compliance, export controls, due diligence, and trade compliance operations.Collaborate with Legal, Procurement, Logistics, Finance, and other business functions to support compliance objectives.
Required QualificationsBachelor’s degree in International Business, Supply Chain, Political Science, Intelligence Studies, Criminal Justice, Business Analytics, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field.2+ years of experience in trade compliance, regulatory or legal support, due diligence, risk management, investigations, regulatory compliance, customs, export controls, sanctions screening, financial crime prevention, corporate research, or a related analytical function.Experience in investigative research, skip tracing, or similar entity research.Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis techniques.Excellent written and verbal communication skills.Demonstrated accuracy and strong attention to detail.Ability to manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

rows.title: Applied Researcher I
rows.descriptionText:
Overview:

At Capital One, we are creating trustworthy and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description:

The AI Foundations team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our work touches every aspect of the research life cycle, from partnering with Academia to building production systems. We work with product, technology and business leaders to apply the state of the art in AI to our business.

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how customers interact with their money. Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, Lightning, VectorDBs, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data. Build AI foundation models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation. Engage in high impact applied research to take the latest AI developments and push them into the next generation of customer experiences. Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals. 

The Ideal Candidate:

You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing AI foundation models and solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Has a deep understanding of the foundations of AI methodologies. Experience building large deep learning models, whether on language, images, events, or graphs, as well as expertise in one or more of the following: training optimization, self-supervised learning, robustness, explainability, RLHF. An engineering mindset as shown by a track record of delivering models at scale both in terms of training data and inference volumes. Experience in delivering libraries, platform level code or solution level code to existing products. A professional with a track record of coming up with high quality ideas or improving upon existing ideas in machine learning, demonstrated by accomplishments such as first author publications or projects. Possess the ability to own and pursue a research agenda, including choosing impactful research problems and autonomously carrying out long-running projects. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, AI, Mathematics, or related fields, with an exception that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, AI, Mathematics, or related fields plus 2 years of experience in Applied Research

Preferred Qualifications:

PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or related fieldsLLMPhD focus on NLP or Masters with 5 years of industrial NLP research experienceMultiple publications on topics related to the pre-training of large language models (e.g. technical reports of pre-trained LLMs, SSL techniques, model pre-training optimization)Member of team that has trained a large language model from scratch (10B + parameters, 500B+ tokens) Publications in deep learning theory Publications at ACL, NAACL and EMNLP, Neurips, ICML or ICLR

Optimization (Training & Inference)PhD focused on topics related to optimizing training of very large deep learning models Multiple years of experience and/or publications on one of the following topics: Model Sparsification, Quantization, Training Parallelism/Partitioning Design, Gradient Checkpointing, Model Compression Experience optimizing training for a 10B+ model Deep knowledge of deep learning algorithmic and/or optimizer design Experience with compiler designFinetuningPhD focused on topics related to guiding LLMs with further tasks (Supervised Finetuning, Instruction-Tuning, Dialogue-Finetuning, Parameter Tuning) Demonstrated knowledge of principles of transfer learning, model adaptation and model guidanceExperience deploying a fine-tuned large language model

rows.title: Analyst, NA Growth Marketing
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

VAS Regional Growth Marketing is Visa's in-market growth engine for Value-Added Services — the function that translates regional business priorities into marketing action. We partner directly with sales, GTM, and regional product teams to identify growth opportunities, remove adoption barriers, and orchestrate the right marketing channels at the right moments. We are a global team embedded across five regions: AP, CEMEA, EUR, LAC, and NA. This is not an events coordination role. It is an entry point into strategic B2B growth marketing at one of the world's most recognized brands.

The Analyst, Regional Growth Marketing will support the execution and measurement of field marketing programs for Visa's Value-Added Services portfolio — spanning Issuing Solutions, Risk and Identity, and Acceptance — within their assigned region. Reporting to the Regional Growth Marketing Director or Senior Marketing Manager, this role is designed for an analytically sharp, commercially curious marketing professional who wants to build expertise at the intersection of B2B strategy, demand generation, and financial services.

This role is responsible for budget management, commercial performance analysis, pipeline visibility, install base insights, partner marketing and executive reporting that enable informed business decisions and growth investments. The successful candidate will partner closely with Marketing, Sales, GTM, Finance, Operations, and external partners to translate data into actionable recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness, resource allocation, and business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Support the planning and execution of regional growth marketing programs — including executive engagement events, industry conference activations, digital campaigns, account-based marketing initiatives, and partner programsPartner with Sales, GTM, Finance, Operations, and Marketing teams to align priorities and reporting.Conduct install base, customer, segment, and whitespace analysis to support retention and expansion strategies.Manage pre-event and post-event processes: attendee communications, briefing materials, follow-up coordination, and CRM updatesDevelop region-specific collateral — event materials, sales support content, program recaps — in coordination with creative and content teamsSupport the adaptation of global campaigns, content, RFP’s, and sales materials for regional and sub-regional market relevanceTrack and report on program performance against defined KPIs — pipeline influenced, account engagement, event ROI, and campaign metricsMaintain and update priority account lists, engagement tracking, and marketing dashboards in collaboration with Demand OperationsSynthesize performance data into clear, concise summaries that inform regional planning decisionsSupport planning and execution of joint marketing initiatives with strategic partners, resellers, acquirers, financial institutions, and technology partners.Support coordination of marketing budget tracking, forecasting, and spend governance across growth marketing programs and events.Identify investment risks, budget variances, and optimization opportunities.Analyze marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline performance, conversion trends, and growth opportunities.Coordinate project milestones, stakeholder communications, approvals, and execution activities across internal and external teams.Support quarterly business reviews, leadership presentations, annual planning, and strategic initiatives.Serve as the operational connective tissue between regional growth marketing and central teams — Campaigns, Demand Operations, and Product MarketingSupport regional directors and senior managers in preparing for business reviews, planning sessions, and stakeholder communications.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

2 or more years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree or an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD, or PhD).

Preferred Qualifications

3 or more years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD).Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Analytics, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in marketing analytics, growth marketing, commercial planning, partner marketing, revenue operations, or business analysis for B2B technology, SaaS, fintech, payments, or financial services.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into business recommendations. Experience developing executive-level reporting, dashboards, and presentations. Familiarity with AI tools used in marketing workflows is an advantage — including large language models for research and content drafting (ChatGPT, Claude), AI-assisted analytics and insight synthesis, AI-powered features within marketing platforms or generative tools for creative and localization work. Experience working with AI tools, CRM, marketing, and reporting platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics, Power BI, Tableau, Marketo, Adobe, or similar technologies. 

Skills And Attributes

Knowledge of pipeline management, account-based marketing, revenue attribution, and funnel analytics. Analytically minded — you are comfortable with data and use it to inform decisions, not just report outcomesOrganized and dependable — you manage multiple workstreams without dropping detailsCommercially curious — you want to understand the business, the customer, and why marketing decisions matter, not just how to execute themStrong written and verbal communication; able to produce clear briefs, summaries, and program materials and deliver professional presentations to leadershipComfortable using AI as a force multiplier in day-to-day marketing work — for research synthesis, brief writing, content drafting, data summarization, and ideation; approaches AI as a tool for better thinking, not a substitute for itCollaborative and low-ego; you contribute to a team that moves fast and values substance over activityCulturally aware; comfortable working across time zones and with global and regional stakeholders.

Information for US Applicants

For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $109,700.00 to $ 170,200.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.

Work Hours

Varies upon the needs of the department.

Travel Requirements

This position requires travel 5-10% of the time.

Mental/Physical Requirements

This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law, including the requirements of Article 49 of the San Francisco Police Code.

Overview:

From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description:

The AI Foundations team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our work touches every aspect of the research life cycle, from partnering with Academia to building production systems. We work with product, technology and business leaders to apply the state of the art in AI to our business.

In this role, you will: 

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how customers interact with their money. Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, Lightning, VectorDBs, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data. Build AI foundation models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation. Engage in high impact applied research to take the latest AI developments and push them into the next generation of customer experiences. Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals. 

The Ideal Candidate:

You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing AI foundation models and solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Has a deep understanding of the foundations of AI methodologies. Experience building large deep learning models, whether on language, images, events, or graphs, as well as expertise in one or more of the following: training optimization, self-supervised learning, robustness, explainability, RLHF. An engineering mindset as shown by a track record of delivering models at scale both in terms of training data and inference volumes. Experience in delivering libraries, platform level code or solution level code to existing products. A professional with a track record of coming up with high quality ideas or improving upon existing ideas in machine learning, demonstrated by accomplishments such as first author publications or projects. Possess the ability to own and pursue a research agenda, including choosing impactful research problems and autonomously carrying out long-running projects. 

Basic Qualifications:

This role combines applied research with hands-on engineering and offers the opportunity to influence both architecture and roadmap decisions.ResponsibilitiesDevelop and optimize deep learning models for depth estimation, object detection, segmentation, tracking, and 3D scene understanding using multi-modal sensor data.Build scalable pipelines for data processing, training, evaluation, and deployment into real-world and real-time systems.Design labeling strategies and tooling for automated annotation, QA workflows, dataset management, augmentation, and versioning.Implement monitoring and reliability frameworks, including uncertainty estimation, failure detection, and automated performance reporting.Conduct proof-of-concept experiments to evaluate new algorithms and perception techniques; translate research insights into practical prototypes.Collaborate with robotics, systems, and simulation teams to integrate perception models into production pipelines and improve end-to-end performance.Preferred QualificationsStrong experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX).Background in computer vision tasks such as detection, depth estimation, segmentation, tracking, or 3D scene understanding.Proficiency in Python; familiarity with C++ is a plus.Experience building training pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and ML deployment workflows.Knowledge of 3D geometry, sensor processing, or multi-sensor fusion (RGB-D, LiDAR, stereo).Experience with data annotation tools, dataset management, and augmentation techniques.Familiarity with robotics, simulation environments (Isaac Sim, Gazebo, Blender), or real-time systems.Understanding of uncertainty modeling, reliability engineering, or ML monitoring/MLOps practices.

rows.title: AI-Native Software Engineer (New Grad)
rows.descriptionText:
Our mission is to open the door to the life-changing impact of education. We build market-leading, online college credit and test-preparation solutions that help working adults earn their degrees, advance their careers, and achieve economic mobility. Recognized by Fast Company and GSV 150 as one of the world’s most innovative education companies, we are also at the forefront of AI-first learning, combining artificial intelligence with the latest learning science to improve access and outcomes at scale.
Our product is our impact. Through our Keys to College and Keys to the Classroom initiatives, we have saved students over $700 million in tuition and enabled hundreds of thousands of learners to pursue and succeed in careers across nursing, teaching, counseling, business, and other high-demand fields. We are deeply focused on measurable outcomes and building products that create meaningful, lasting change in people’s lives.
You're early in your career and you already ship real software with AI coding agents. Here that's just how we work. We want you doing it for millions of learners from your first week.
About the RoleEngineering at Study.com is AI-native. Our engineers direct coding agents every day, inside an agent framework we built ourselves: skills that teach agents our codebase and conventions, guardrails that keep them on the rails, and evaluation that tells us whether the output is good. We define what "done" means and hold the bar on quality, security, and architecture; the agents do the typing. The question on our teams is no longer whether to use AI, but how much further it can go.
You will join a cross-functional team and grow into the work alongside the engineers around you. You will take features from acceptance criteria to production: understand the problem with product and design, break it into work an agent can execute, drive the agents, test what comes back, and see it ship to real students and teachers. This is a role for learning the craft, with the support to do it well. Architecture, security, and system-wide decisions stay with the team while you build toward them. Engineers who grow here move on to larger scope and their own product areas.
This role is based in our Mountain View, CA office and is hybrid in office Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays.
What You'll DoBuild and ship features with AI coding agents (Claude Code and similar tools) as your primary way of producing software.Work across our stack: Java and Spring services, MySQL, and TypeScript/React frontend.Write the tests and acceptance criteria that tell an agent when a feature is done.Work with your team to review and ship your code.Flag the skills and guardrails that fail you, and help make them better.Follow your features after release: watch the metrics, take the feedback, and learn from the trade-offs your team makes.
Your First 90 DaysDays 1 to 30: Ship to production in your first week, with help close at hand. By the end of the month you have several features live and you know your way around the product and the codebase.Days 30 to 60: Take on larger features. Understand the metric each one is meant to move, ship it, and follow through on what the data says. Land your first improvement to a skill or guardrail the team uses.Days 60 to 90: Work on features with more ambiguity in them. Join the technical design discussions for your team's work and start contributing to them. Move faster on the paths you now know well.
What You'll LearnIn your first year you will get good at:Breaking a product problem into work an agent can execute well, and spotting when it has not.Reading a diff critically, and taking a review on your own work.Testing and observability practice on a system that real students depend on.Our stack, end to end, and where its load-bearing parts are.When to trust what an agent hands you, and when to go read the code yourself.
What You'll Bring to the RoleEvidence that you build and ship software. Internships, personal projects, open source, and hackathon work all count. Show us the things.Hands-on experience using AI coding tools to build non-trivial functionality, and opinions about where they excel and where they still need a human.Working proficiency in at least one general-purpose language (Java or TypeScript preferred) and familiarity with how web applications fit together, front end through database.Solid fundamentals in data structures and algorithms.Clear written communication. Much of your work is specifying intent precisely, for people and for agents.A BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field, recently completed or expected before your start date.
Nice to HaveA portfolio or GitHub that shows a pattern of finishing and shipping things, especially things built largely with agents.Experience with Java and Spring, React, SQL, or NoSQL databases.Experience writing prompts, skills, or evaluations that make LLM-based tools more reliable.A habit of finishing what you start, and of asking about the things that look wrong.
CompensationThe hourly pay range for this position is $43.00 – $59.00 per hour. This range reflects the full pay progression for this level. New hires, including recent graduates, typically begin in the lower portion of the range and grow their pay as they gain experience within the role. Actual pay depends on factors including skills, work experience, business needs, and market demands. This is a non-exempt position and is eligible for overtime in accordance with applicable law.

rows.title: Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
Who You Are

You are a data scientist, an experienced quantitative thinker who wants to develop further as both a data scientist and an engineer. You are skilled at finding the precise mathematical kernels of real-world business challenges faced by leading international financial institutions. You want to apply your expertise in statistics and computer science using Quantifind’s state-of-the-art infrastructure to solve problems in Natural Language Processing, such as Entity Resolution, Document Classification, building Knowledge Graphs, and Topic Modeling. You are excited to work at a fast-growing company where you will have the chance to expand your scientific and engineering skills in new areas. You share Quantifind’s commitment to winning together and are eager to see your coworkers build on the technical foundations you will be creating. You are passionate about maintaining the high scientific and engineering standards required to enable your peers. Above all, you are a curious and independent problem solver who is motivated to find a place where your skills can have a real impact.

You’re looking to explore a client-facing role at the intersection of software and consulting. You are obsessed with the idea of delighting clients at some of the world’s leading Financial Institutions, helping them identify financial crimes.

You have always been a strong critical thinker and know how to problem solve.

You are an excellent communicator with the ability to distill complex concepts into clear and effective verbal and written presentations. You are comfortable working closely with Sales, Product, and Technology teams to promote a Customer Centric culture.

You have an entrepreneurial spirit with a deep sense of personal accountability for work product quality and always take the initiative to propel work products to new heights. You maintain a positive attitude even in a deadline-driven environment, bring out the best in others, and enjoy contributing to the success of the team.

Who We Are

Quantifind is the Risk Intelligence company. We help some of the world’s biggest banks identify money laundering and fraud. Quantifind also works with government agencies, using the same platform, to uncover criminal networks and support national security. Unlike other players in this space, Quantifind delivers results through an AI-driven software-as-a-service (SaaS) solution with consumer-grade user experiences.

Quantifind’s Graphyte platform uncovers signals of risk across disparate and unstructured text sources using artificial intelligence and natural language processing techniques. In financial crimes risk management, Quantifind’s solution uniquely combines internal financial institution data with public domain data to assess risk in the context of Know Your Customer (KYC), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Fraud Risk Management, and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) processes. Today, these compliance processes are burdened by ever-increasing regulatory responsibilities and an expectation of frictionless transactions. Legacy technologies demand increasingly more human resources as the operations expand; Quantifind’s solution offers a way to cut through the inefficiency and enhance effectiveness simultaneously. Demand for this solution is fueling our rapid growth.

To help you succeed, we provide a supportive environment that fosters collaboration between teams and team members, where learning and professional growth are considered a key part of your success, and of ours. We offer a flexible work environment with a family-friendly work-life balance.

What a Great Candidate Looks Like

Master’s degree or higher in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.At least 2 years of professional industry experience, in addition to your academic experience.Proficient in two or more of the following: Scala / Java, Python, R.Outstanding quantitative and analytical ability. Able to take less-than-precise business requirements and translate them into Quantitative problems that you enjoy solving.In-depth knowledge of Statistics / Probability / Machine Learning, including foundations such as bias/variance trade-off, regularization, dimension reduction, and model explanation.Prior experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP) methods such as Word and Contextual Embeddings, Named Entity Recognition, Topic Modeling, large-scale Document Classification, and Sequence-to-Sequence Models is a significant plus.Ability to apply software engineering best practices to build scalable, reliable ML pipelines. Comfortable prototyping algorithms, iterating quickly, and working collaboratively.Prior experience working with large-scale datasets (Millions of records) using SQL and Spark.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, prior experience explaining assumptions, conclusions, and methodology to technical and non-technical audiences. 

The Opportunity We Offer 

Quantifind is seeking to fill a Data Scientist position on our Data Science team. We work closely with the Product Management team and Platform engineers to anticipate company needs and quickly put state-of-the-art mathematical tools into the hands of end users. Members of the Data Science team translate real-world problems into quantitative language, find or create algorithms to solve those problems, and implement them in code. Our team values a creative and empathetic approach to problem-solving and strives to maintain rigorous scientific and engineering standards. We will give you the opportunity to work on the full spectrum of data science challenges, bringing solutions from research all the way to production.

Quantifind’s development team is centered in Palo Alto, California, and we have technology hubs in Atlanta, Georgia, and Washington, D.C. Quantifind is currently using a hybrid mix of working from home and in the office, with regular in-person touchpoints and shared office space.

A Highlight Of Our Benefits

Competitive salary Company Equity Exceptional benefits package Flexible Vacation & Paid Time Off Employer-matched 401(k) plan A fun environment where work-life balance is valued 

The base salary range for this full-time position is $140,000 to $170,000. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location, and the range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, role-related knowledge and skills, depth of experience, relevant education or training, and additional role-related considerations.
