All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, sex, age, national origin, religion, physical or mental disability, pregnancy/childbirth and related medical conditions, veteran or military status, or any other characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact us.

EEO is the Law | E-Verify | Right to Work

Total Rewards

At Noblis we recognize and reward your contributions, provide you with growth opportunities, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, and work-life programs. Our award programs acknowledge employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our service standards. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in our benefit programs. Other offerings may be provided for employees not within this category. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Benefits page on our Careers site.

Compensation at Noblis is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the combination of education, certifications, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, internal and external equity, location, clearance level, as well as contract-specific affordability, organizational requirements and applicable employment laws. rows.title: AI/ML Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
ABS Group is seeking an AI/ML Engineer to join our Artificial Intelligence Practice in support of a major federal modernization program. In this role, you will design, develop, and operationalize machine learning and artificial intelligence solutions that support mission applications and data-driven workflows.

You will help bring AI capabilities into production, build supporting pipelines and model operations workflows, and work across data science, engineering, and cloud teams to deliver scalable, secure, and trustworthy AI solutions. The scope of responsibility, degree of technical leadership, and level of independence expected will reflect the level at which this position is filled.

What You Will Do

- Design, develop, and operate AI and machine learning capabilities for production applications and data workflows


- Build and maintain data and model pipelines that support training, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management


- Partner with data scientists, developers, and cloud engineers to productionize AI solutions


- Implement MLOps and related engineering practices for model deployment, monitoring, retraining, and version control


- Support generative AI and large language model implementations, including prompt workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, and vector-based retrieval patterns


- Apply AI/ML to adjacent use cases such as test automation, workflow support, and operational optimization


- Contribute to CI/CD, observability, and operational support for AI systems in secure environments


- Support responsible AI and model governance practices, including explainability and compliance requirements


- Document architectures, workflows, and engineering standards for project delivery


What You Will Need
Level and Compensation: This position may be filled at multiple career levels based on business need and the selected candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, and demonstrated capability. Typical leveling for this role is as follows:
- Junior (0 to 4 years)

- Mid-Level (5 to 9 years)

- Senior (10 to 14 years)

- Principal (15 or more years)

These ranges are guidelines only and are not the sole determining factor in level. The posted compensation range reflects the full range across all possible levels. Individual offers will be based on the level at which the candidate is hired, as well as factors such as skills, experience, internal equity, and geographic market considerations where applicable.


Education and Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related technical field; Master's degree preferred


- Relevant professional experience in AI engineering, machine learning engineering, or related software engineering roles; the depth and scope of experience required will vary based on the level at which this position is filled


- Experience deploying or supporting machine learning and AI systems in production environments preferred


- Experience working in cloud-based or hybrid technical environments preferred

-


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

- Proficiency in Python


- Familiarity with frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit-learn


- Familiarity with MLOps, CI/CD for ML, and model monitoring concepts and practices


- Exposure to LLMOps, AIOps, RAG, and vector databases


- Experience building or supporting data pipelines for AI/ML applications


- Understanding of software engineering and DevSecOps practices for production systems


- Strong collaboration skills across technical teams and stakeholders

-


Nice to Have

- Experience supporting production ML at scale


- Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP AI/ML services


- Familiarity with federal, public sector, or regulated AI environments


- Exposure to NLP, classification, survey analytics, or entity resolution use cases

Location

This position is based in the Washington, D.C. metro area, with primary work performed in Suitland, Maryland. Remote or hybrid arrangements may be available for eligible work, subject to government approval.

rows.title: Assistant Professor- Tenure Track
rows.descriptionText:
Posting Summary

Job Title Assistant Professor- Tenure Track Division Divison of Academic Affairs Department School of Social Work - Bachelors Work Status Full Time Position Category Faculty Faculty Rank Assistant Professor FLSA Exempt Pay Range Exempt Salary Range $75,000 - $120,000 (based on discipline) Fund Source State Support Job Summary

Morgan State University invites applications for full-time tenure-track faculty in the School of Social Work. The expected start date is August 2026. The position will be a dual appointment in the BSW Department & School of Social Work Center on Urban Violence & Crime Reduction. The Center on Urban Violence & Crime Reduction at Morgan State University focuses on addressing violence and crime through evidence-based research and community engagement.

We seek candidates who have a strong desire to contribute to a growing School at one of the nation’s largest Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCU). The program offers the BSW, MSW, Online MSW, Online DSW, and PhD degrees and currently has approximately 600 students. Both the BSW and MSW Programs are fully accredited by CSWE. The mission of Morgan’s School of Social Work is to prepare urban practitioners and leaders, policy experts, knowledge producers, scholars, and social work educators who are committed to solving urban issues and problems and improving the quality of life for urban people and communities. Special focus is on urban children, youth, and families, gerontology, and public health social work within a social and economic justice framework.

Founded in 1867 and located in Baltimore, Maryland, Morgan State University has been designated by the state as Maryland’s Pre-eminent Public Urban Research University with an R2 Carnegie classification. Morgan’s mission is to serve a multiethnic and multiracial student body and to help ensure that the benefits of higher education are enjoyed by a broad segment of the population. The university offers a comprehensive range of academic programs, including 35 master’s degrees and 20 doctoral programs, e.g., master’s and doctorate in education, public health, master’s and doctorate in nursing, doctorates in psychometrics, business, engineering, and history, along with 10 online degree programs, including the online MSW degree.

The Faculty Search Committee will begin reviewing applications and nominations immediately and will continue until the position is filled.

Job Duties

Strong grounding in racial equity, social justice, and emancipatory frameworks across teaching, research, and serviceKnowledge of CSWE accreditation standards and curriculum development for BSW and MSW programsUnderstanding of substance abuse, social welfare policy, and generalist/advanced social work practiceExperience with community-engaged and participatory research methodologiesDemonstrated capacity for scholarly research, peer-reviewed publication, and grant-funded research, including securing and managing extramural fundingEffective undergraduate teaching skills, including curriculum design, assessment, and student-centered pedagogyProven mentorship, advising, and communication skills with diverse undergraduate and graduate studentsCapacity to teach across multiple content areas, particularly policy, substance abuse, and social work practiceCommitment to advancing the mission and growth of the School of Social Work and the Center on Urban Violence & Crime Reduction

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Other Characteristics

Comprehensive knowledge of social work theory, practice, and policy with a focus on urban contextsExpertise in urban violence prevention and crime reduction, including evidence-based and community-centered approachesAbility to balance teaching, research, and service responsibilities in a tenure-track roleAbility to inspire, prepare, and develop students as ethical, equity-minded urban practitioners and leadersAbility to engage effectively with urban communities through service, research, and partnershipAbility to work within a diverse, multiethnic, and multiracial academic environment, including an HBCU context.Ability to maintain an active, productive research agenda aligned with tenure expectations.Ability to integrate engaged learning, technology-enhanced instruction, and online or hybrid teaching modalitiesStrong interdisciplinary collaboration skills with faculty, research centers, and community partnersAbility to translate research into practice, policy, and meaningful community impact

Required Minimum Qualifications

The position involves research, teaching, and related service.The candidate must have a doctorate in social work or a related field and a master’s degree in social work.A demonstrated commitment to social work practice in urban environments as demonstrated through funded research, teaching, and service are required.Demonstrated ability to collaborate across disciplines with community partners are also expected.Research in the areas of urban violence & crime reduction highly desired.Priority will be given to candidates who are able to teach in the areas of policy, substance abuse, and practice.Priority will be given to candidates with experience and a strong commitment to student-centered pedagogy and engaged learning.Candidates must be able to demonstrate research excellence and productivity, including the ability to maintain a successful program of extramural funding and a commitment to racial equity and emancipatory practice, research and service.

Other Preferences for Consideration

The Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER) performs an essential public health task by making sure that safe and effective drugs are available to improve the health of people in the United States. As part of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), CDER regulates over-the-counter and prescription drugs, including biological therapeutics and generic drugs. These efforts cover more than just medicines.

Research Project: This research opportunity supports data mining and database development efforts in the cardiovascular safety space, with a focus on advancing regulatory science through systematic analysis of nonclinical and clinical cardiotoxicity data. You will contribute to the development and curation of comprehensive databases designed to evaluate the current landscape of cardiovascular safety data used in drug development and regulatory decision-making.

You will investigate and apply advanced data mining techniques, statistical modeling, and computational tools to identify patterns, gaps, and trends across large datasets relevant to cardiac safety including human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocyte (hiPSC-CM) data, ion channel pharmacology, in vivo and clinical QT data, and other cardiotoxicity endpoints. Through this, you will collaborate with FDA scientists to analyze how real-world and experimental data can be leveraged to inform translational regulatory strategies.

This research will contribute to the development of innovative approaches for integrating large-scale cardiovascular safety datasets into the regulatory review process, advancing FDA's regulatory science mission and public health objectives.

FDA Office and Location: A research opportunity is available immediately with the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER), located in Silver Spring, Maryland.

The Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER) performs an essential public health task by making sure that safe and effective drugs are available to improve the health of people in the United States. As part of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), CDER regulates over-the-counter and prescription drugs, including biological therapeutics and generic drugs. These efforts cover more than just medicines.

Research Project: Characterizing the Trends and Opportunities for Streamlining Evidence Generation involving Pharmacodynamic Biomarkers - Pharmacodynamic biomarkers are increasingly central to drug development and regulatory decision-making. Their uses range from identifying target engagement, selecting doses to use in clinical trials, selecting patients, monitoring safety, performing exposure-response analysis, providing or confirming evidence as endpoints, etc. However, recurring limitations include unclear clinical relevance, variability, and bioanalytical challenges. UL Research Institutes

Electrochemical Safety Research Institute

We see what’s on the horizon and use our expertise to build the foundations of a safer future. You’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of human understanding as part of a team working to advance the public good.Grow and achieve: We learn, work, and grow together through targeted development, reward, and recognition programs.Values. Four core values guide our work: collaboration, respect, integrity, and beneficence. By living our values, we inspire the trust essential to fulfilling our mission and foster the partnerships that enable us to pursue a beneficent future in which we all can thrive.Total Rewards: All employees at UL Research Institutes are eligible for bonus compensation. We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans and a generous 401k matching structure of up to 5% of eligible pay. Moreover, we invest an additional 4% into your retirement saving fund after your first year of continuous employment. Depending on your role, you may be able to discuss flexible working arrangements with your manager. We also provide employees with paid time off, including vacation, holiday, sick, and volunteer days.

What Makes You a Great Fit

While no one candidate will embody every quality, the successful candidate will bring many of the following professional competencies and personal attributes:

Proven ability to perform independent research and support publication.Demonstrated general knowledge of scientific disciplines in electrochemistry and materials science and engineering. Demonstrated ability to maintain academic and applied knowledge and skills.Ability to collaborate with peers and work directly with other team members and external collaborators in order to complete a project from start to finish.Excellent report, publication, presentation and general communication skills required.

Professional Education And Experience Requirements For The Role Include

Ph.D. in chemistry, materials science and engineering, and related engineering conferred within three years of application or completion of Ph.D. requirements by commencement of appointment.Experience working in an electrochemistry or materials lab required.

About UL Research Institutes And UL Standards & Engagement

UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement are nonprofit organizations dedicated to advancing safety science research through the discovery and application of scientific knowledge. We conduct rigorous independent research and analyze safety data, convene experts worldwide to address risks, share knowledge through safety education and public outreach initiatives, and develop standards to guide safe commercialization of evolving technologies. We foster communities of safety, from grassroots initiatives for neighborhoods to summits of world leaders. Our organization employs collaborative and scientific approaches with partners and stakeholders to drive innovation and progress toward improving safety, security, and sustainability, ultimately enhancing societal well-being.

rows.descriptionText:
Organization

Reference Code

How To Apply

To submit your application, scroll to the bottom of this opportunity and click APPLY.

A Complete Application Consists Of

An applicationTranscripts – Click here for detailed information about acceptable transcriptsA current resume/CV, including academic history, employment history, relevant experiences, and publication listOne educational or professional recommendation

All documents must be in English or include an official English translation.

If you have questions, send an email to ORISE.FDA.CDER@orau.org. Please include the reference code for this opportunity in your email.

Application Deadline

11/20/2026 3:00:00 PM Eastern Time Zone

Description

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling-basis.

FDA Office and Location: A research opportunity is available immediately with the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER), located in Silver Spring, Maryland.

The Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER) performs an essential public health task by making sure that safe and effective drugs are available to improve the health of people in the United States. As part of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), CDER regulates over-the-counter and prescription drugs, including biological therapeutics and generic drugs. These efforts cover more than just medicines.

Research Project: Characterizing the Trends and Opportunities for Streamlining Evidence Generation involving Pharmacodynamic Biomarkers - Pharmacodynamic biomarkers are increasingly central to drug development and regulatory decision-making. Their uses range from identifying target engagement, selecting doses to use in clinical trials, selecting patients, monitoring safety, performing exposure-response analysis, providing or confirming evidence as endpoints, etc. However, recurring limitations include unclear clinical relevance, variability, and bioanalytical challenges. This project will aim to identify trends in new drug approvals in the use of biomarkers in regulatory evaluation and identify the opportunities to inform and advance the development and application of biomarker-based information in drug development.

Learning Objectives: Under the guidance of a mentor, you will:

Examine and understand how pharmacodynamic biomarkers are used in drug development and regulatory decision-making.Analyze trends in new drug approvals including use of biomarker for target engagement, dose selection, patient selection, safety monitoring, as endpoints and in exposure-response analysis.Develop an understanding of common challenges affecting pharmacodynamic biomarker use, such as uncertain biological variability, clinical relevance, and bioanalytical challenges.Identify opportunities to streamline, strengthen, and expand the development and application of pharmacodynamic biomarkers in drug development.Build skills in regulatory science, data review, and assessment of biomarker-based information.

Mentor: The mentor for this opportunity is Anuradha Ramamoorthy (Anuradha.Ramamoorthy@fda.hhs.gov). If you have questions about the nature of the research, please contact the mentor.

Anticipated Appointment Start Date: September 2026. Start date is flexible and will depend on a variety of factors.

Appointment Length: The appointment will initially be for one year, but may be renewed upon recommendation of FDA and is contingent on the availability of funds.

Level of Participation: The appointment is full time.

Participant Stipend: The participant will receive a monthly stipend commensurate with educational level and experience.

Citizenship Requirements: This opportunity is available to U.S. citizens, Lawful Permanent Residents (LPR), and foreign nationals. Non-U.S. citizen applicants should refer to the Guidelines for Non-U.S. Citizens Details page of the program website for information about the valid immigration statuses that are acceptable for program participation.

This program, administered by ORAU through its contract with the U.S. Department of Energy to manage the Oak Ridge Institute for Science and Education, was established through an interagency agreement between DOE and FDA. The participant will receive a monthly stipend commensurate with educational level and experience. Proof of health insurance is required for participation in this program. Participants do not become employees of FDA, DOE or the program administrator, and there are no employment-related benefits.

Completion of a successful background investigation by the Office of Personnel Management is required for an applicant to be on-boarded at FDA. OPM can complete a background investigation only for individuals, including non-US Citizens, who have resided in the US for a total of three of the past five years.

Qualifications

The qualified candidate should be currently pursuing or have received a doctoral degree in the one of the relevant fields.

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. and executing consumer research plans across multiple markets, managing research requirements and budgets, translating learning into action, and overseeing the development of master packaging designs from ideation through implementation, leading gross margin enhancement programs, and maintaining existing formulations, claims, and product compliance in response to evolving regulations, industry standards, and market requirements.

Extensive marketing experience within the Consumer Health sector, with strong expertise in developing and executing brand growth strategies in a complex and regulated environment.Demonstrated excellent strategic thinking combined with commercial acumen, including a strong understanding of business performance drivers, P&L management, and portfolio optimization.Proven ability to leverage consumer, market, and performance data to identify trends, generate insights, and translate them into actionable strategies that drive growth, while navigating regulatory requirements across categories such as OTC medicines, medical devices, and VMS.Proven experience leading innovation programmes from concept through to launch, with a strong track record of delivering successful consumer-led innovations. rows.title: Logistics Director - Reckitt US
rows.descriptionText:
We are Reckitt

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.

Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

Supply

Our supply chain is the backbone of our business. It's how we get our trusted products to people all over the world, safely and efficiently. And it's our talented and passionate teams that make this happen.

If you're looking for a career in supply chain, there's no better place to be than Reckitt. We offer a variety of exciting opportunities in all areas of the supply chain, from planning and procurement to manufacturing and logistics. You could join our Global Supply Planning team to develop and implement our global supply strategy, or work with our Procurement Centre of Excellence team to negotiate and manage our supplier relationships.

Our Manufacturing Excellence team help us improve the efficiency, quality and safety of our manufacturing operations, and our Logistics Excellence team develop new and innovative ways to distribute our products to customers.

About The Role

The Logistics Director US is responsible for leading and optimizing the logistics operations across North America, ensuring efficient, cost-effective, and customer-focused delivery of goods. This role oversees transportation, warehousing, and distribution, and plays a critical role in strategic decision-making, financial delivery, process improvement, and cross-functional collaboration. Scope includes managing logistics across 3 different business units and provides indirect guidance to Canada logistics operations.

You will showcase strategic leadership through developing and executing logistics transformational strategies including automation, network design, freight management, embellishment, and flexible labor. You will lead strong partnership with 3PLs to drive more efficient and effective operations and achieving best in class performance. You will possess strong knowledge of financial delivery through a robust productivity process and ability to connect logistics metrics with financial performance and have a continous improvement ad root cause analysis mindset.

Your responsibilities

In the role of Logistics Director, you will demonstrate operational excellence, overseeing transportation, warehousing, and distribution operations, ensuring compliance with safety, regulatory and environmental standards. You will monitor KPIs and implement corrective actions to meet performance targets and oversee the delivery of monthly shipments and course correct where needed to delivery business targets.

You will lead, mentor and develelop a high perfoming logistics team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and innovation.

You will manage relationships with third-party logistics providers (3PLs), carriers, and suppliers and negotiate contracts and service level agreements to optimize cost and service. You will champion the use of best in class logistics technologies (e.g., TMS, WMS, ERP) and support digital transofrmation initiatives.

Finally, you will possess strong customer focus, collaborating with Customer Service and Sales to ensure timely and accurate deliveries.

The experience we're looking for

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or related field.15+ years of progressive experience in logistics or supply chain management, with at least 10 years in a leadership role.Proven track record of managing complex logistics networks and driving operational improvements.5+ years experience working in Customer Service, Planning, and other Supply Chain rolesStrong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills.Experience with logistics systems and data analytics tools.Ability to travel domestically as needed.

The skills for success

Supply Chain Management, Business Partnership, Collaboration, Partnership building, Relationship management, Business acumen, Productivity management, Project management, Improve business processes, Advanced analytics, Data analytics, Manufacturing excellence, Leadership.

What we offer

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.

We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes.

For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.

Equality

We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

,

The Senior Manager will use customer behavior across Ralph Lauren’s e-commerce, full-price retail and outlet businesses to identify lifecycle opportunities, expand addressable audiences and deliver more relevant experiences across the customer journey.

The ideal candidate is strategic, hands-on, highly collaborative and brand-conscious, with the ability to move seamlessly between customer planning, campaign execution, performance analysis and cross-functional leadership.

Campaign & Cross-Functional Leadership

Performance, Testing & Optimization

Own CRM reporting and forecasting across Email, SMS and App, translating performance into actionable insights and recommendations.Socialize performance, key learnings, risks and growth opportunities with cross-functional partners and senior leadership.Lead the test-and-learn roadmap and partner with Analytics to strengthen measurement and optimize engagement, conversion, retention and customer value.

Team Leadership, Innovation & Ways of Working

Manage and develop three direct reports, providing clear priorities, coaching and opportunities to build broader CRM capabilities.Identify and implement AI opportunities across CRM workflows to drive efficiency, accelerate insights and improve planning, reporting, testing and execution.Partner with agencies, technology providers and internal teams to evolve capabilities and ways of working

Salary range: $85,000 - $161,444 annually,

7+ years of CRM/lifecycle marketing experience, ideally within DTC, fashion, luxury or retail, with a track record of driving measurable growth across Email, SMS and other customer touchpoints.Deep expertise in Email and SMS, with experience in App Push or mobile messaging and hands-on ownership of campaigns, triggered programs and automated journeys.Strong analytical and commercial mindset, with experience using first-party data, segmentation, personalization, forecasting, testing and performance optimization to drive decisions.Ability to balance performance rigor with strong brand instinct, moving comfortably between customer insights, creative review, content strategy and messaging.Experience managing agencies and external partners, including setting clear direction, challenging thinking and holding teams accountable for strong outcomes.Clear, confident communicator who can translate customer and performance insights into actionable recommendations for senior leadership and cross-functional partners.Curious, externally aware and passionate about CRM, customer behavior and the evolving retail landscape, with a desire to bring fresh thinking into the work.Proactive, action-oriented and quality-focused, with demonstrated interest in applying AI or emerging tools to improve insights, performance and team efficiency.

rows.title: Associate Director, Sustainability Data and Digital Systems
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

Job Purpose / Overview: 

This role is the strategic architect and lead executor of the Mars Snacking sustainability digital strategy. This is a mission-critical role in the team because of the high reliance of sustainability teams on data and systems:

Sustainability teams rely on data and systems to plan, execute and defend our work. Regulatory scrutiny on sustainability continues to increase, requiring more robust systems, processes and data controls. To identify new impact opportunities, we need expanded connectivity and granularity of data feeding our sustainability calculations. And to drive more sustainable change within the business, we need to increasingly connect sustainability impacts and information end to end, from Soil to Snack. Our digital strategy will create a path by which all functions can contribute to Mars' sustainability plans, while also unlocking brand and customer connections to foster growth.

Key Responsibilities: 

 Develop and execute Digital Sustainability Strategy:Build a multi-year digital strategy which serves Mars Snacking sustainability's strategic priorities, new global/regional operating model, and embedding of sustainability into the businessPartner cross-functionally to identify interdependencies and opportunity areas where sustainability data & systems can support other teams and vice versa (e.g., Resilience)Secure and direct digital funding in partnership with Snacking Digital Technologies and Data & Analytics teams, and Corporate Sustainability/ MGS' Sustainability Mission Control program (SMC)Implement the digital strategy and manage Snacking Sustainability systems and analytics needs across all sustainability impact areas and teams, ensuring balanced prioritization. Partner with regional leads and transformation lead to define data & performance flows between region/ division & center team, and vice versa.Work with Mars Snacking & Mars Inc Sustainability Controllership to define appropriate data controls and ways of working to serve those control needs. Seek to automate these controls over timeDefine & communicate clear processes and data expectations for project level substantiation for external communication

Context & Scope 

As the digital sustainability leader and process owner for Mars Snacking, this role will partner closely with:

The Snacking Sustainability team (including center & regional teams) : Defining and prioritizing the needs of the digital strategy across pillars, defining key internal SME partnerships & ways of working.Cross-functional Snacking digital leads and GXOs: Aligning the digital sustainability strategy and defining cross functional sustainability integration points.  Preferred: 7+ years’ recent experience working in sustainability accounting and data in a matrixed CPG company. parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands.

At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.

,

The Manager, Product Planning supports Ralph Lauren's Integrated Business Planning (IBP) model by driving product planning activities across assigned Brands and Categories within the IBP Control Tower. This role partners closely with Brand Merchandising, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Finance, and Analytics teams to translate merchandising strategies into actionable planning insights and enterprise decision-making. Through structured planning routines, analytics, and executive-ready materials, this role helps improve assortment productivity, product performance, and cross-functional alignment throughout the seasonal planning lifecycle.

,

Support product planning activities across assigned brands and categories, ensuring seasonal planning milestones, inputs, outputs, and follow-up actions are completed on time. Develop executive-ready decision materials that clearly articulate product planning choices, business impacts, key metrics, trade-offs, risks, and recommended actions. Translate planning dashboards, data, and performance metrics into concise business insights for Brand Merchandising and IBP leadership. Track decisions, action items, ownership, and open questions across product planning forums and key seasonal planning milestones. Analyze product planning metrics including SKU productivity, Birthed CCs, Produced CCs, Commonality, adoption rate, revenue per SKU, sell-through, margin, and AUR performance. Partner with Analytics and Product Planning leadership to standardize recurring reporting, planning templates, data inputs, and planning routines. Identify opportunities to improve planning processes, decision-making, and cross-functional collaboration. Support planning discussions by providing clear, data-driven recommendations and insights.

Salary range: $65,000 - $129,225 annually,

Experience in merchandising, product planning, merchandise planning, business planning, retail strategy, forecasting, or related analytical functions. Strong understanding of seasonal merchandise planning processes, product lifecycle management, assortment planning, and retail performance metrics. Ability to synthesize complex business information into clear insights, recommendations, and executive-level narratives. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to connect data to business decisions. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience working with dashboards, reporting tools, and planning systems. Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and planning cycles simultaneously. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across functions without direct authority. Ability to operate effectively in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Job Description:

The Senior Manager, Outside Counsel Management role is responsible for the strategy, governance, performance, and financial management of the company's global outside counsel and alternative legal services provider (ALSP) portfolio. This role serves as the primary steward of legal spend, law firm relationships, billing governance, panel management, and vendor performance across all practice areas and geographies.

Working closely with the General Counsel, Legal Leadership Team, Center of Legal Excellence (Mars Legal Operations), Finance, and Mars Managing Attorneys, this role drives the department's outside counsel strategy to ensure the company receives the highest quality legal services at the best overall value.

This individual combines legal industry expertise, financial acumen, data analytics, vendor management, and change leadership to optimize legal service delivery and continuously improve the legal department's operating model.

What are we looking for?

8–15+ years’ experience in one or more of the following:Legal operationsOutside counsel managementLegal procurementLaw firm pricingLegal vendor managementLarge corporate legal department operations Experience working within a multinational corporate legal departmentExpert level experience with outside counsel management platformsExperience with AI-enabled legal operations solutions

What will be your key responsibilities?

Global Outside Counsel Strategy & Governance

Develop and maintain the enterprise-wide outside counsel strategy.Design and manage law firm panel programs, preferred provider arrangements, and strategic partnership frameworks.Establish governance standards for engagement, selection, evaluation, and offboarding of law firms and legal service providers.Drive consistency in outside counsel management across business segments, regions, and legal practice areas.Serve as the primary advisor to legal leadership on outside counsel market trends, alternative service delivery models, and emerging legal industry developments.

Matter Management & Billing Governance

Own outside counsel billing governance and compliance programs.Maintain and enforce outside counsel guidelines.Oversee eBilling and matter management platforms.Establish billing controls and invoice review processes.Monitor compliance with billing guidelines, budget requirements, etc.Drive continuous improvement in billing accuracy and spend transparency.

Legal Technology & Digital Transformation in eBilling

Expert usage of, and awareness of the evolving space, in the following categories:

eBilling systemsRFP toolsData and tools (e.g. PowerBI, Tableau, etc.)AI-enabled legal technologiesMatter management platforms

Work with over 130,000 diverse and talented Associates, all guided by The Five Principles.Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Location

CINCINNATI GENERAL OFFICES

Job Description

Are you passionate about applying technology to solve business problems? Do you want to oversee a digital product throughout its entire product cycle? The Digital Product Manager/Owner is responsible for setting a product strategy and vision, communicating it early and often. You’ll understand your customer needs and translate them into valuable, feasible, and usable products that bring business benefits — defining and maintaining Roadmaps, Personas, and Backlogs while managing cost of ownership, and working with agile teams to bring your digital products to life.

In NA Fabric Care's Business Transformation team, you won't just manage a backlog — you'll be hands-on-keyboard in Airtable, architecting bases, automations, interfaces, and portals to define, build, deploy, and operate low-code digital tools that deliver employee simplification and process improvement across the organization. You'll own and grow real products that teams rely on every day, as well as create new, innovative approaches to driving real change for the organization through Airtable.

Responsibilities

Build in Airtable, hands-on — design and maintain bases, tables, relational data models, automations, interfaces, and portals to deliver working simplification products end-to-end.Own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog — understand and represent customer needs within your Product Team, align the vision with stakeholders and communicate it often, and prioritize features and capabilities according to business priorities.Define, track, and improve the Value KPIs for your product — user adoption, engagement, and productivity/time-savings gains.Define the Personas for your products to guide simplification and self-serve experiences for employee and external partner (agency/freelancer) end-users.Investigate bugs and issues, and define a plan to resolve them quickly — triage, prioritize, and drive fixes to keep products stable and trusted.Write and maintain documentation on new and existing products — clear, current documentation that strengthens our ability to present products to stakeholders, upskill team members quickly, and understand product architecture when upgrading, migrating, or resolving bugs.Plan, migrate, and train teams from existing tools into corporate solutions when ready — managing the transition and enabling end-users for smooth adoption.Manage interdependencies and integrations — understand relationships with other products/capabilities, and define new integration designs and implementation plans connecting Airtable solutions to enterprise data and workflows (e.g., APIs, Power Automate) across the broader NA Fabric Care product portfolio.Ensure product deployments comply with data governance, InfoSec, privacy, and regulatory requirements — including support for application registration, iRisk, pentest, and other stewardships and governance areas for the product(s) you support.Operate and govern the tools you build — support adoption, data management, and day-to-day operations in line with NAFC’s Airtable administration, governance, and operations standards; communicate system constraints and partner with collaborators to assess innovation opportunities and new business cases.

Required:

A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Informatics, Engineering, or a related field.Experience or demonstrated aptitude in digital product management, customer success, or related roles within complex, multi-stakeholder environments.Demonstrated ability to understand business needs and translate them into clear product intent, disciplined scope, and fit-for-use data and analytics capabilities.Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies, and workstreams in parallel.Familiarity with agile product development and DevOps ways of working.Understanding of data governance, privacy, security, and compliance requirements.Experience designing and implementing digital solutions using low-code/no-code platforms to simplify business processes and improve user experiences.Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with both business and technical stakeholders.Ability to work hybrid schedule in Cincinnati, OH based office.

Preferred:

Experience in Airtable or other low-code/no-code tools as a power builder — relational data modeling, automations, interfaces, portals, and API integrations.Experience building or working in a relational database, database design, and row-level security.Certification as Professional Scrum Master (PSM) or DevOps Foundations.Familiarity with integration and automation tooling (Power Automate, REST APIs, webhooks) to connect Airtable with enterprise systems.Exposure to GenAI productivity tools (e.g., ChatPG, M365 Copilot) and interest in applying AI/automation to simplify employee workflows.Experience developing and deploying production software or business applications, with a history of solving hard problems with creative solutions.Experience working with globally owned platforms and contributing to regional go-to-market, adoption, and value delivery.Understanding of data governance, privacy, security, and compliance requirements.Experience with Python, Markdown, and GitHub.

rows.title: Planogram Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Summary

The Planogram Specialist partners with Category Leadership Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to influence, build, validate, and execute merchandising solutions that support category growth. The role co-owns planogram development, planogram specific reporting, database maintenance, and ad hoc category analytics while evolving toward stronger process leadership, standardized ways of working, and scalable tools that improve speed, quality, and consistency across divisions. The role also contributes to assortment and layout thinking by applying shopper, category, retailer, and performance insights to strengthen shelf construct recommendations, planogram testing, heat mapping, and best-practice deployment.

Responsibilities

Planogram Development & Execution

 Builds multiple versions of planograms based on pre-established assortment, clustering nuances, fixture variations, merchandising guidelines, and retailer-specific requirements, while simultaneously developing customer-specific Gold Standard POG recommendations that optimize product flow, brand blocking, adjacencies, capacity, and execution feasibility to drive immediate merchandising objectives and support long-term category growth, shopper navigation, and strategic retailer goals. Reviews, validates, and revises planograms for adherence to retailer strategy, merchandising standards, fixture /labor realities, and execution readiness. Manages relay execution for assigned categories, including workload forecasting, project coordination, deadlines, and issue resolution required for successful implementation. Provides planogram support for display merchandising where applicable, including virtual store environments, 3D product builds, video tours, promotional concepts, and customer-facing visual assets that communicate the merchandising story.

Assortment, Layout & Shelf Strategy Support

 Supports assortment and layout strategy development by translating shopper, category, retailer, and performance insights into informed shelf recommendations. Contributes to planogram testing, heat mapping, clustering evaluations, fixture alternatives, and shelf construct analysis to improve category and brand outcomes. Provides analytical support for innovation, renovation, and new item/segment display considerations as needed.

Reporting, Analytics & Decision Support

 Conducts ad hoc analytics to answer business questions from Customer Merchants, Category Advisors, Category Leadership Managers, and non-advising teams. Supports business reviews and insights development using available resources such as Circana, JDA/Blue Yonder, retailer data, and internal reporting. Measures effectiveness of planogram, assortment, and shelving actions by connecting execution outputs to performance indicators where available.

Tools, Data & Capability Enablement

 Helps develop and improve the planogram toolbox, including standardized tables, templates, reporting views, process documents, and shared knowledge resources. Identifies opportunities to test, validate, and scale tools or automation that improve planogram development, reporting, and execution efficiency. Supports onboarding, training content, and best-practice sharing for analysts, field category teams, and partners using planogram or space planning tools. Maintains strong relationships with Shopper MX and key internal stakeholders to optimize merchandising tools, data integrity, digital assets, and operational processes, driving efficiencies, improving execution quality, and identifying scalable, cost-effective solutions that advance category management capabilities and customer outcomes.

Collaboration & Thought Leadership

 Acts as an efficient collaborator by sharing reporting, best practices, learnings, and reusable tools across divisions and customer teams. Brings forward-thinking recommendations through proposals, planogram testing insights, heat mapping, and scalable process improvements that support total Nestlé growth. Builds trusted relationships with Category Leadership, Space Planning Management, field sales, and cross-functional partners to improve quality, speed, and alignment.

Requirements

Education & Experience

 Bachelor’s degree in related field preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience. 2+ years of experience in Space Management and/or Category Management; CPG and/or food industry experience required, with demonstrated ability to influence merchandising recommendations through buyer-facing storytelling, cross-functional partnership, and category strategy application.

Technical & Analytical Skills

 Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel; advanced analytical aptitude and ability to develop business and category knowledge, including the expertise to simplify complex data into clear visuals, shelf stories, and executive-ready recommendations. Experience with Blue Yonder/JDA Space Management preferred; ability to use SQL, Python, or similar tools to improve data extraction, analysis, or planogram workflows a plus. Ability to use retailer, marketplace, shopper, category, and performance data to address business questions and improve merchandising recommendations.

Core Capabilities

 Strong project management, prioritization, and change-management skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables independently and in a team environment. Excellent presentation, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to translate analysis into clear recommendations. Demonstrates a meticulous attention to detail when developing and validating planograms, ensuring accurate product placement, compliance with retailer requirements, and flawless execution of best-in-class merchandising recommendations Demonstrated initiative, tenacity, curiosity, and problem-solving; willingness to challenge current ways of working and help build future-state capabilities. Ability to collaborate across Category Leadership, Field Sales, and cross-functional partners while sharing knowledge and best practices.

Travel

Approximately 15–25% to include national meetings, local customer meetings, store visits, and other business needs.

Salary: $80,946.32 to $109,431.70 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at https://www.nestlejobs.com/nestle-in-the-us-benefits

It is our business imperative to remain a very inclusive workplace.

All the details

As part of the M&S Software Engineering team, you’ll be joining a well-loved historic brand, working on solutions that serve millions of loyal customers and thousands of colleagues. With ethical values that run right through the company’s core and technology leaders that truly understand software engineering, it’s an exciting time as we’re redefining ourselves into a digital-first, engineering-led organisation, with the quality of our engineering team being a key differentiator.

This role sits within our Warehouse Platform team, supporting the Fashion, Home & Beauty (FH&B) Supply Chain & Logistics sub-domain, a core part of M&S’s growth plans. What’s in it for you?

Working at M&S means being part of something bigger – helping to deliver quality, value and service to millions of customers every day. We’re inclusive, fast-moving and always evolving, with a strong sense of purpose and a focus on doing the right thing.

Businesses that partner with Ocado Solutions come in all shapes and sizes, and leverage our technology in different ways. rows.descriptionText:
Requirements

 Description & Requirements 

Note: there is only one position, however, the team is open to hiring in New York (Remote) or LA (Hybrid).

Who We Are

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.

About This Team

The Global PR manager will be responsible for identifying real-time trends taking place in culture, responding in real-time with ideas that drive earned media, and delivering regular insights, measurement, and analytics across all Global PR efforts.

This person will sit on the Global PR team and work closely with regional and cross-functional teams and agency partners to lead always-on PR. They will use media monitoring and social listening tools to identify bubbling themes emerging across fashion, sports, lifestyle, and entertainment that are relevant for our brand, and identify authentic ways to insert lululemon into the conversation that ultimately drive earned. They will also deliver actionable insights and recaps to better inform Global PR strategies and show the impact of the collective Consumer PR team’s work.

The ideal candidate is at the forefront of culture and knows how to move at the speed of it to drive cultural relevance, has experience using media monitoring and social listening tools, has a pulse on the latest media intelligence platforms and tools, and confidence in knowing how to use data to inform public relation strategies.

Core Responsibilities

Leads always-on PR by conducting proactive and reactive media monitoring and social listening to identify timely insights, themes, and trends emerging in culture to act on in real-time (ex: news jacking) and drive cultural relevance.Has an earned-first mindset and can deliver and execute ideas, in partnership with the Consumer PR team and the Social Media team, that drive earned media based on the insights and themes they identify.Establishes our Global PR insights, measurement, and analytics program globally, building templates, processes, and reports.In collaboration with internal partners (ex: Regional PR teams, Global Brand Insights, Social Insights) and external PR agency to deliver quarterly Global PR reports and all global campaign and initiative-specific reporting with a focus on meaningful insights and analysis that can shape future strategies.Sets the strategy for what key indicators we measure across all global initiatives and the recommended KPIs, while regularly tracking progress towards goals.Provide regional PR teams with guidance and support on earned media insights, measurement and analytics.Manage and oversee our media monitoring management tool, as well as identify additional tools to help further improve our insights and analytics capabilities.Tracking competitor earned media activity and sharing learnings and insights back with cross functional partners and leadershipProvide operational support to the global PR team as needed.

Qualifications

7-10 years of professional experience in public relations, media monitoring, social listening, and analytics.Proficient knowledge and hands-on experience with media monitoring, social listening and reporting tools, specifically Meltwater and Muckrack, along with Sprinklr, Brandwatch, Netbase and TalkWater from a social listening perspective.Experience writing Boolean logic and query-based searches.Experience creating reports and visualizations in PowerPoint, Keynote and Excel.A news and culture expert who knows what’s taking place across fashion, sports, lifestyle, and entertainment.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong presentation skills, and ability to isolate takeaways for leadership.Able to quickly and easily develop relationships with people across cultures and geographies.Bachelor’s degree in public relations or related discipline. Fluent in English.

must haves

 Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life. Possess an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovate to achieve great results. Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same. Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure. Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships. Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take yourself too seriously.

Additional Notes

Authorization to work in the United States is required for this role.

Please note: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visa at this time for this role.

Compensation And Benefits Package

lululemon’s compensation offerings are grounded in a pay-for-performance philosophy that recognizes exceptional individual and team performance. The typical hiring range for this position is from $112,000- $147,000 USD annually; the base pay offered is based on market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity. As part of our total rewards offering, permanent employees in this position may be eligible for our competitive annual bonus program and subject to program eligibility requirements.

Recognizing Our Teams For Their Performance And Dedication, Other Components Of Our Total Rewards Offerings Include Support Of Career Development, Wellbeing, And Personal Growth

 Extended health and dental benefits, and mental health plans Paid time off Savings and retirement plan matching Generous employee discount Fitness & yoga classes Parenthood top-up Extensive catalog of development course offerings People networks, mentorship programs, and leadership series (to name a few)

rows.title: Director Marketplace Development and Consumer Insights
rows.descriptionText:
Purpose & Overall Relevance for the OrganizationThe Director, Marketplace Development & Consumer Insights serves as a strategic leader responsible for shaping the future growth agenda of adidas North America through deep consumer understanding, marketplace intelligence, and enterprise-wide strategic planning.

This role sits at the intersection of consumer behavior, commercial strategy, analytics, and innovation, leading the identification of emerging opportunities, risks, and growth vectors across channels, categories, consumers, and geographies.

The Director is accountable for establishing a world-class Consumer Insights capability spanning qualitative, quantitative, behavioral, location-based, synthetic, and AI-enabled research methodologies. Through the translation of insight into action, this role drives enterprise decision-making and influences priorities across Brand, Commercial, Product, Strategy, Finance, and Executive Leadership teams.

In parallel, this role leads Marketplace Development efforts to shape the future marketplace ecosystem, ensuring adidas remains competitive, consumer-led, and differentiated across physical and digital channels.________________________________________Key Responsibilities

Consumer Insights LeadershipEnterprise Consumer Intelligence Strategy

 Establish a comprehensive consumer intelligence ecosystem connecting consumer needs, motivations, barriers, behaviors, and purchase drivers to business decision-making. Translate complex consumer, market, and competitive dynamics into actionable strategic recommendations for senior leadership. Identify future growth opportunities through consumer trend forecasting, whitespace analysis, and emerging market identification. Serve as the organization's thought leader on consumer behavior, retail trends, and marketplace evolution.

Research & Insight GenerationOwn and govern the end-to-end consumer insights practice across multiple methodologies including:

 Qualitative Researcho Focus Groups & In-Depth Interviewso Shop-Alongs & Consumer Immersionso Online Communities & Digital Diaries Quantitative Researcho Brand Trackingo Usage & Attitude Studieso Segmentation & Concept Testingo Pricing Research & Conjoint Analysiso Market Sizing & Opportunity Assessments Behavioral Researcho Digital Analytics & E-Commerce Behavioro Customer Journey Analytics & Conversion Funnel Analysiso Path-to-Purchase Research In-Market Researcho Retail Experience Studies o Store Intercept Programs & Shopper Missionso Mystery Shopping & Marketplace Evaluationso Competitive Benchmarking Spatial & Location Intelligenceo Trade Area Analysis & Consumer Mobility Analysiso Site Selection Intelligenceo Geographic Demand Forecasting & White Space Opportunity IdentificationAI & Synthetic Research Innovation Establish synthetic research methodologies as a complementary capability to traditional consumer research. Develop frameworks for hypothesis generation, testing, validation, and decision support using AI-powered consumer intelligence. Drive innovation in predictive consumer analytics, synthetic audiences, and simulation-based decision making.________________________________________Marketplace Development Leadership

Strategic Marketplace Planning

 Identify growth opportunities across channels, consumers, categories, geographies, and key cities. Develop strategic recommendations regarding market expansion, investment prioritization, distribution strategy, and marketplace optimization. Lead analyses assessing marketplace attractiveness, competitive positioning, consumer demand potential, and commercial opportunity.Marketplace Intelligence & Project Execution Integrate consumer, competitive, market, financial, and business intelligence into a unified strategic view of marketplace performance. Continuously assess evolving marketplace conditions and proactively identify emerging risks and opportunities. Lead high-priority, cross-functional strategic initiatives from opportunity identification through execution and operationalization.

________________________________________Leadership, Collaboration & Organizational InfluenceEnterprise Leadership

 Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders across Commercial, Brand, Finance, Product, Business Development, Operations, and Strategy functions. Influence decision making through fact-based recommendations, compelling storytelling, and executive-ready insight synthesis. Represent Consumer Insights and Marketplace Development within senior leadership forums and strategic planning processes.

Cross-Functional PartnershipDevelop strong partnerships across:

 Brand Product Creation Commercial (Retail, Wholesale, E-Commerce) Finance Strategy Data & Analytics Technology Consumer Engagement Global Marketplace Strategy Global Consumer Insights External Research Partners

Team Leadership

 Build and develop a high-performing team of insight, analytics, and strategy professionals. Foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, learning, and continuous improvement. Drive capability building across the organization through education, frameworks, and best-practice sharing. Coach and mentor team members while developing future leadership talent.________________________________________

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

 Deep expertise across qualitative, quantitative, behavioral, and applied consumer research methodologies. Strong understanding of retail, wholesale, digital commerce, shopper behavior, and marketplace dynamics. Demonstrated experience developing and implementing enterprise-level consumer insights strategies. Expertise in hypothesis-led problem solving, consumer trend forecasting, and strategic planning. Strong understanding of emerging AI technologies, machine learning applications, synthetic research methodologies, and advanced analytics. Exceptional executive communication, storytelling, and influence skills. Proven ability to simplify complex insights into actionable business recommendations. Strong financial, analytical, and strategic problem-solving capabilities. Ability to influence senior executives without direct authority. Experience leading large-scale cross-functional initiatives and organizational change.________________________________________Requisite Education & Experience 10+ years of experience across Consumer Insights, Strategy, Analytics, Marketplace Development, Commercial Strategy, or related functions. Proven leadership experience managing high-performing teams and enterprise-wide initiatives. Experience within leading consumer goods, retail, apparel, sportswear, technology, or consulting organizations. Demonstrated success influencing executive-level decisions through research, analytics, and strategic recommendations. Experience implementing AI-enabled research, advanced analytics, or innovation capabilities preferred. Master's Degree or MBA preferred.

rows.title: Head of Operations, Global Affairs
rows.descriptionText:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

EA's Global Affairs Team is looking for a leader of the Global Affairs operations team enabling a 200-person Global Affairs organization. The Global Affairs team comprises of Legal, Business Development, Corporate Development, Governmental Affairs, Procurement, among other groups. You'll lead strategic initiatives to ensure operational excellence, financial discipline and technology enablement. You will report to the Senior Vice President, Legal Affairs and also work closely with EA's Chief Legal Officer and Chief Business Officer. This is a full-time hybrid position, requiring three days a week in one of these office locations: Redwood City, CA, Los Angeles, CA, or Seattle, WA.

Join us in driving the next revolution in games.

Responsibilities

Serve as a strategic advisor to the Chief Legal Officer, Chief Business Officer, the Senior Vice President, Legal Affairs and the Global Affairs leadership team and partner with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure the department's operations effectively support enterprise goals.Design and deliver a Global Affairs operations strategy aligned to business priorities. Lead and collaborate in efforts to optimize the delivery of services to the business. Own and deliver large cross functional projects. Organize and facilitate leadership team and department meetings and events.Lead and develop the Global Affairs Operations team, setting clear expectations, coaching team members and building a service-oriented culture.Manage the Global Affairs budget planning and management.Select and manage technology solutions to drive efficiency in the department – including contract lifecycle management, AI tools, e-Billing, analytics and workflow automation.Partner with department leaders to manage outside counsels, technology providers, staffing providers and managed services relationships.Partner with department leaders and People Experience on talent planning, job architecture, onboarding and other department-wide people processes.

Qualifications

Experience leading an operations function with 10+ years of operation experience across people, processes and technology within a corporate or law firm setting.A bachelor's degree in a related field.Strong financial planning and management skills with experience in budget oversight and analysis.Demonstrated people leadership experience, building high-performing teams.Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and manage complex projects.Experience overseeing technology solutions and AI initiatives. Experience working with vendors and law firms on engagement and billing practices.Strong communication skills with the ability to build trust, influence decisions and drive alignment across functions. Able to explain financial, operational and technical issues in direct, practical language.A pragmatic 'get it done' attitude with the ability to navigate ambiguity, represent Global Affairs leadership across the enterprise and prioritize projects that provide the most value to the department.

Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES

 California (depending on location e.g. Los Angeles vs. San Francisco) *$182,600 - $276,300 USD Washington (depending on location e.g. Seattle vs. Spokane) *$175,600 - $233,600 USD

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

In the US, we offer a package of benefits including paid time off (3 weeks per year to start), 80 hours per year of sick time, 16 paid company holidays per year, 10 weeks paid time off to bond with baby, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

rows.title: Assistant Manager Digital Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
DUTIES: Responsible for delivering cutting-edge analytics services to stakeholders, enabling them to make fact-based decisions. Based on multiple data sources, manage the generation of insights that help adidas understand consumer behavior and related business performance to ultimately help drive sales. In collaboration with your team, inform the adidas digital market strategy and provide the factual basis for future consumer experiences and related demand and site development. Contribute to continuous development of the analytics practice in scope, including service portfolio evolution and aligned to global frameworks for focus areas assigned to you. Potential focus areas are: Digital Business Performance analytics, Digital Product Performance Insights, Digital Operational Analytics (Forecasting, SLAs, Returns, Supply Chain, Trading & Data Governance), Digital Experience Analytics (.com and app), ad Digital Analytics Projects. Manage demand for insights and analytics. Conduct collection, tracking, mining and analysis of data and the generation of fact-based insights using multiple data sources. Provide analytics services to stakeholders within the eCom market. Ensure analytics results drive consumer experience and business impact and help achieve market sales plans. Support stakeholders in your area of responsibility in the use of digital analytics to define goals, select appropriate KPIs, monitor performance and derive trends and opportunities. Provide stakeholders with actionable recommendations and calls for action based on your gathered insights. Translate gathered insights into engaging, actionable and easy to digest insights presentations. Maintain a strong stakeholder network with high level of trust that facilitates action-ability of insights. Implement and use data driven decision processes, in line with a fact-based decision culture. Co-initiate and help implement new reporting structures or refine existing structures within your area of responsibility in alignment with Global Digital Analytics Frameworks and Data Governance. Help influence best practice guidance to other markets and other adidas stakeholders to maximize the use of analytics capabilities. Build internal and external network, informing the adidas Digital Analytics community on the latest trends and technological advances.

REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Business, or a related field of study, and Two (2) years of experience in Digital Analytics. Work experience must have included: 1 (one) year of experience with management skills including the ability to lead projects or work on several projects simultaneously; Experience in eCommerce environment; Experience with BI, Financial, Merchandising processes, tools and KPIs; Experience with analytics tools and disciplines (web, eCom, or mobile); Experience with SQL; Experience with visualization tools and techniques (including Power BI, or Tableau, Alteryx); Knowledge of MS Office, Adobe Analytics/Google Analytics, and App Analytics platforms; Experience with Smartsheet; and Experience with market/consumer research tools (including Market360 or MRI Simmons). Travel required Domestically and Internationally 10-20% of the time for meetings.

JOB SITE: 5055 N. Greeley Avenue, Portland, OR 97217. May permit telecommuting from home office within commuting distance to Portland, OR
