rows.title: International Aggregators Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Domino’s Pizza, which began in 1960 as a single store location in Ypsilanti, MI, has had a lot to celebrate lately: we’re a reshaped, reenergized brand of honesty, transparency and accountability – not to mention, great food! In the rise to becoming a true technology leader, the brand is now consistently one of the top five companies in online transactions and 85% of our sales in the U.S. are taken through digital channels. The brand continues to ‘deliver the dream’ to local business owners, 90% of which started as delivery drivers and pizza makers in our stores. That’s just the tip of the iceberg…or as we might say, one “slice” of the pie! If this sounds like a brand you’d like to be a part of, consider joining our team!

Job Description

The International Aggregators Business Manager supports Domino’s Pizza International’s Aggregator Center of Excellence (COE). The mission of the role is to help international markets define and execute strategies that drive incremental sales on third-party aggregator platforms while reinforcing Domino’s brand positioning across channels.

This role partners closely with International Markets, Business Teams, and cross-functional COEs to support effective aggregator strategies that are commercially impactful, operationally sound, and aligned with broader market priorities across channels including Carryout and 1P Delivery. The Manager helps translate best practices and market learnings into practical tools, recommendations, and execution support for priority markets.

Responsibilities

Aggregator Strategy Consulting

Support international markets in defining, refining, and optimizing aggregator strategies that drive sales growth while reinforcing Domino’s brand positioning. Provide hands-on support to priority markets, helping move initiatives from opportunity assessment through execution. Advise markets on best practices for balancing aggregator growth with long-term business sustainability across owned and third-party channels. Identify risks, dependencies, and operational constraints related to aggregator initiatives and partner cross-functionally to help address them. Support test-and-learn initiatives across the aggregator experience to improve conversion, customer satisfaction, and overall performance. 

Knowledge Development and Deployment

Help capture, organize, and evolve Domino’s international point of view on third-party aggregators through market learnings, examples, and best practices. Support the development and maintenance of scalable frameworks, playbooks, tools, and guidance that enable consistent and effective execution across aggregator platforms. Prepare materials and support structured knowledge-sharing forums that accelerate learning and adoption across DPI and International Markets, including recurring Aggregator Forum content and follow-up actions.  Partner cross-functionally to support communication and rollout of aggregator products, features, and initiatives.  Provide guidance to markets on platform execution standards and customer experience expectations across aggregator platforms. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with DPI Business Teams, Digital teams, and other COEs to align aggregator priorities with business and commercial objectives. Build effective working relationships with stakeholders in International Markets and support follow-through on agreed priorities, timelines, and deliverables. Maintain awareness of aggregator platform capabilities, industry trends, and competitive dynamics to help inform recommendations and support market needs. Support continuous improvement of shared tools, processes, and ways of working across the Aggregators COE. 

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or related field required. 5+ years of experience in digital, eCommerce, consulting, aggregator strategy, or related fields; QSR, franchisor, or multi-market experience preferred. Familiarity with third-party aggregator platforms, digital customer journeys, and commercial execution principles. Ability to use analytics and insights to inform recommendations and support performance improvement.  Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams with attention to detail.  Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions, cultures, and markets. Self-starter with strong ownership, sound judgment, and comfort working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. International experience and second-language proficiency preferred. Ability to travel internationally (approximately 15–20%). 

Additional Information

Benefits:

 Paid Holidays and Vacation   Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents Childcare tuition discounts No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs Fertility benefits Adoption assistance 401k matching contributions   15% off the purchase price of stock   Company bonus  

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

rows.title: Sr Software Engineer, Ads Auctions & Marketplace Optimization
rows.descriptionText: Teamwork makes the stream work. Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.  What does the team work on? Roku is the No. 1 TV streaming platform in the US, Canada and Mexico, with more than 100 million active accounts. Every ad impression across that platform has to be cleared and priced in real time — that is what the Ads Auctions and Marketplace Optimization team does. We build the auction mechanics, the pricing and pacing logic, and the low-latency systems that run them, balancing outcomes for advertisers, publishers, viewers, and Roku on every request. We are growing the team in Cambridge, which is becoming its largest hub, alongside colleagues in Amsterdam, Austin, San Jose, Ukraine and Uruguay — so you would be shaping how the UK side of this team works rather than inheriting it.What is the role? You will build the systems that apply mathematical and algorithmic rigour to optimise across multiple objectives, deciding which ads get served, in which placements, and when. The work spans auction mechanics, optimisation, the output of predictive ML models, and the real-time infrastructure underneath, mostly in Java on the JVM. It is hands-on and senior in scope: expect to move between whiteboard-level design and production code in the same week, and to own problems from framing through rollout. You will work directly with the hiring manager and a small group of senior engineers, in codebases shared with other ads engineers, on problems where your decisions are visible in revenue. You will optimise for second-order effects in a marketplace where participants react to each other, and to us, in real time. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic about solving these kinds of problems.How will I use AI at Roku? At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.What are the responsibilities of the role? Design and build components of Roku's real-time ad auction and marketplace systemsOwn the multi-objective optimisation at the core of the auction, balancing what advertisers, publishers, viewers, and Roku each want from the same impressionOwn development work end to end, from framing the problem through production rolloutBuild and operate JVM services where latency and reliability are product requirements, not stretch goalsUse probability, statistics and experimentation to test changes before and after launchWork with AI tooling as a normal part of how you design, build, test and reviewExplain technical trade-offs clearly to engineering and cross-functional partnersWhat experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku? Around six or more years building production software, with strong systems judgementProduction experience in Java or another JVM language, or depth in a comparable statically typed language such as C#, C++ or Go, and the appetite to ramp on JavaComfort designing and operating distributed systems at scale and low latencyA solid grounding in maths, algorithms, probability and statistics as applied to real systemsDemonstrated AI and agentic-tooling fluency, as described aboveAd tech, auctions or marketplace experience is preferred, and we move quickly for candidates who have itComparable experience on mathematically rigorous or optimisation-heavy problems in another domain is an acceptable alternative What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com. What should I know about Roku's culture?Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

rows.title: Director, Global English Publisher Partnerships, Deal Architecture and Enablement
rows.descriptionText:
Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

As Audible continues to revolutionize audio entertainment, we are seeking a strategic deal-maker to serve as the Director, Global English Publisher Partnerships, Deal Architecture and Enablement. This role drives deal success across Audible's third party publisher relationships, leading negotiations directly while architecting creative deal structures that deliver measurable business outcomes for the broader team.

You will own a portfolio of publisher relationships and negotiations for the Global English Publisher Partnerships organization, managing deals from initial discussions through execution. Reporting to the Senior Director, Global English Publisher Partnerships, you will negotiate commercial terms directly with publishers, develop deal structures, and collaborate with Finance, Legal, Product, and cross-functional teams to shape how Audible values and structures its third party publisher relationships. You will also enable the broader deal team by translating business performance insights into negotiation approaches and deal frameworks that advance the team's objectives.

About You

You are a deal-maker with strong business acumen and financial modeling capabilities. You combine negotiation expertise with the ability to value complex deal structures and the communication skills to influence senior leadership and cross-functional partners. You're equally comfortable leading high-stakes negotiations, building deal valuation models, and presenting recommendations that drive investment decisions. You thrive in ambiguity, ask the right questions, and have a proven ability to close deals while elevating the capabilities of those around you. You have a passion for audio storytelling and digital media.

As a Director, Global English Publisher Partnerships, Deal Architecture and Enablement, you will...

 Lead deal negotiations and manage commercial relationships directly with publishers across Audible's English language markets globally, owning deals from initial discussions through execution Design innovative deal structures that balance publisher and Audible objectives, collaborating with Finance, Legal, Product, Strategy, and the Publisher Partnerships team to optimize deal economics Build valuation models and conduct scenario testing to inform your negotiations and evaluate deal trade-offs, including P&L development and ROI analysis Develop negotiation approaches informed by business performance trends across the 3rd party publisher ecosystem, identifying opportunities that shape deal structures for your portfolio and the broader team Monitor the competitive landscape and industry trends to identify emerging opportunities, competitive threats, and positioning considerations that strengthen negotiations and publisher relationships Support the Senior Director and deal team by translating business performance insights into negotiation frameworks and deal approaches that can be applied across the publisher portfolio Create executive communications and presentation materials that articulate deal recommendations, financial implications, and business rationale for content investments and publisher opportunities Lead publisher-facing business reviews and performance discussions, including Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), that strengthen relationships and inform ongoing deal optimization Drive communication cadence with publishers and internal stakeholders on performance, providing thought leadership on the publishing industry and content trends that inform deal discussions Build trust and credibility as a go-to deal partner for Global English Publisher Partnerships, combining negotiation expertise with financial acumen and business judgment Champion efficiency within the Publisher Partnerships team through automation and AI tools, reducing manual work to focus team capacity on deal-making and relationship development Facilitate cross-functional alignment on publisher performance and deal priorities, driving action that improves relationship outcomes Influence decision-making through compelling business cases, clear financial framing, and stakeholder engagement that advances deal objectives

About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic Qualifications

 Bachelor's degree Experience in large complex deal negotiations with a successful track record Experience successfully negotiating and managing content deals Experience driving deal execution for entertainment or media products Demonstrated track record of successful publisher relationship building and management Proficiency in developing financial models and business cases for deal evaluation, including P&L analysis, ROI calculations, and scenario modeling Experience translating business performance insights into negotiation approaches and deal structures Experience with financial modeling and data tools: Excel, SQL, Tableau/PowerBI, Python or R a plus Ability to build compelling business cases and narratives that influence executive decisions and drive negotiation outcomes Problem-solving skills with ability to structure ambiguous problems and develop deal frameworks Effective written and verbal communication skills; ability to express thoughts logically, succinctly, and persuasively in negotiation and executive settings Experience managing multiple competing priorities and delivering under ambitious timelines with high accuracy

Preferred Qualifications

 J.D., or MBA Experience structuring and negotiating complex agreements and leading cross-functional groups to orchestrate and successfully complete deals Experience developing performance frameworks and reporting capabilities that enable deal teams and publisher relationship management Familiarity with content performance metrics that inform deal structures, including consumption patterns, audience insights, and content ROI measurement Experience with AI/ML tools for automation and efficiency Deep understanding of the publishing business, including business models, competitive forces, and industry dynamics Experience collaborating with Business Intelligence and Data Science teams to access insights that inform deal approaches Proven success in content, media rights, or digital media deal-making roles Operational excellence: highly organized with ability to manage complex deals while maintaining detailed accuracy Track record of driving deal discipline and rigor in fast-growing or transformational organizations Passion for audio storytelling and an avid consumer of digital content

rows.title: Senior Engineer, Data Management

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Why Hearst

Hearst is one of the nation's largest diversified media, information and services companies, with a portfolio of more than 360 businesses worldwide. Our consumer businesses include television stations, newspapers, magazines and ownership stakes in cable networks. Our business-to-business companies include Fitch Group, Hearst Health and Hearst Transportation. Across our businesses, you'll find opportunities to do meaningful work, grow your career and make an impact.

About This Role

Hearst Technology Services is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help shape our data and AI technology roadmap. You'll own the full lifecycle of complex data projects — from analysis and design through development and production support — building pipelines and integrations that move data securely and reliably across cloud platforms. You'll also help design the tooling that extracts, transforms, and governs data from both internal systems and external sources, and act as a technical resource for engineers, analysts, and data scientists across the business.

What You'll Do

 Design and build scalable, secure pipelines that ingest, transform, and move large volumes of structured and unstructured data across systems.  Build APIs and complex database logic to automate the fetch, transformation, and storage of data in multiple formats.  Use generative AI tools to accelerate the development, testing, and maintenance of pipelines across Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, and Databricks.  Architect and maintain modular, reusable components that power larger data and AI applications, deployed via containerized workflows (Docker/Kubernetes) where applicable.  Design, build, and maintain data solutions across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.  Implement data quality, security, and governance standards consistently across cloud environments, including integrations between platforms like Informatica IDMC and MDM.  Securely handle PHI, PII, and PCI data in line with regulatory and internal compliance requirements.  Partner with data analysts, data scientists, and IT operations to build tools and pipelines that power new data and AI products — including downstream reporting and BI use cases.  Provide technical leadership on projects: mentor engineers, review designs, and offer guidance on complex technical or production issues.  Apply DevSecOps practices and Agile methodologies (Jira, Scrum/Kanban) to plan and deliver work.  Monitor and improve application performance, resiliency, and scalability as data volumes grow. 

Required

 What You'll Bring  Required 

 7+ years building production data pipelines, with strong Python (or equivalent) and both relational and non-relational database experience.  Hands-on experience with generative AI tools applied to data engineering workflows.  Experience designing and maintaining data solutions on at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).  Experience with ETL tools, data modeling, and building reusable, modular components for complex systems.  Working knowledge of containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) or similar deployment practices.  Experience implementing data governance, security, and quality standards, ideally including regulated data (PHI/PII/PCI).  Experience with Informatica IDMC/MDM or comparable data integration and master-data tooling.  Solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, and software architecture, with experience documenting and testing complex systems.  Comfort working directly with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into pipelines and products.  Experience with Agile delivery (Jira, Scrum, or Kanban) and DevSecOps practices. 

 Nice to Have 

 Prior experience leading a small team of data engineers/analysts.  Experience with data classification and taxonomy tools, particularly within Informatica.  Exposure to BI/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker) to support downstream analytics consumers. 

Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field; Master's preferred.  7+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, including senior or lead-level project ownership. 

In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in New York City. The reasonable estimate, if hired in New York City, is $140,000-$150,000. Please note this information is specific to those hired in New York City. If this role is open to candidates outside of New York City, the salary range would be aligned to that specific location. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education. Hearst provides a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, 401(k), paid holidays and paid time off, employee assistance programs, and more.

Auditor (Products)
Remote: UK - Remote
About RevolutPeople deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. We are looking for an Auditor (Product Operations) to execute end-to-end risk-based audits across Payments, Credit, and Crypto to deliver our 2026/2027 plan. Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

rows.title: Data Science Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

This role is for Angstrom Sports, a proprietary sports pricing and product provider, building intricate, simulation driven pricing and risk systems to support the success of key sports brands across the Entain group.

Founded in 2018 and having established itself as a pioneer in player-level, play-by-play simulations and forecasting, Angstrom was acquired by Entain in 2023. Today, we are responsible for delivering the group’s most advanced pricing and risk capabilities with a focus on the US market. We’re committed to building the next generation of sports betting products - sports-first, recreationally-focused, and designed to make betting more engaging, more intelligent, and more fun.

We’re proud to be a high-performing, low-ego team where brilliant people are empowered and people work to become brilliant. While we’re ambitious and delivery-driven, we take real pride in how we operate and the health of our independent culture, underpinned by mutual trust and respect.

Job Description

We have an exciting opportunity for a talented organiser of people & projects to join our rapidly expanding Sports Analytics company based in London Bridge.

As Data Science Manager, you are responsible for managing the Leads of multiple sport-specific modelling teams. You ensure consistency, alignment, and delivery across the portfolio of models while supporting the career development of Lead Data Scientists.

You will work closely with the Head of Data Science on planning, staffing, and setting the direction for the function. You will be instrumental in scaling the data science capability and ensuring technical quality, delivery efficiency, and team cohesion across the department.

Key Responsibilities

Resource planning of the Data Scientists to optimise departmental objectives and tasks in ongoing projects.Manage, coach, and develop Data Science Leads across multiple teams.Support Leads in planning, prioritisation, and delivery of high-quality forecasting models.Help set and maintain a high bar in technical standards, code practices, and documentation across teams.Identify and address capacity, capability, or performance challenges across the department.Collaborate with Delivery and Engineering counterparts to maintain efficient team operations.Work with the Head of Data Science to shape department-wide strategy, tooling, and hiring plans.Facilitate cross-team learning, innovation, and the sharing of best practices.Act as an escalation point for technical or resourcing issues across teams.Represent the Data Science function in cross-departmental discussions or leadership meetings.Help maintain a collaborative, supportive, and high-performance culture across the modelling organisation.

Qualifications

Essential

Demonstrated success managing Data Science Leads and growing high-performing teams.Skilled in aligning delivery across multiple projects, sports, or technical domains.Strong technical background in model development and deployment, with the ability to support and challenge teams when needed.Advanced programming experience (R/Python/C#/Java)Excellent communication and leadership skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.Proven ability to manage hiring, performance, and team development.Familiar with cross-functional planning, prioritisation, and capacity management.Champions a culture of collaboration, experimentation, and delivery.Domain expertise in sports modelling or betting products.2+ years managing teams and leading delivery across multiple modelling projects

Desirable

Experience building or scaling data science functionsFamiliarity with model governance, risk, or compliance processes.Knowledge of tooling and infrastructure challenges across data and ML teams.Strategic thinking in resource allocation and modelling roadmaps.Passion for modelling excellence and deep awareness of current trends in applied data science.Experience using cloud services (AWS preferred)A degree (PhD, MSc, BSc) in a STEM subject or similar provable numerate and quantitative skills

Additional Information

At Entain, we know that signing top players requires a great starting package, and plenty of support to inspire peak performance. Join us, and a competitive salary is just the beginning.

Depending on your role and location, you can expect to receive benefits like:

Generous bonus schemeHybrid workingPrivate medical insurancePension Scheme - matched to 6%Ability to buy and sell holidayFree subscription to wellbeing app UnmindEntain & Enhance daysSharesave Scheme

Join a winning team of talented people and be a part of an inclusive and supporting community where everyone is celebrated for being themselves.

Should you need any adjustments or accommodations to the recruitment process, at either application or interview, please contact us.

rows.title: Senior Enterprise Architect
rows.descriptionText:
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC, and fulfil your potential - whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Enterprise Architect.

CIB IT delivers technology that powers banking services for corporate, commercial and global banking clients, providing a comprehensive set of capabilities to meet clients’ needs worldwide. Within this, Credit and Capital Management is on a major global transformation programme, with significant investment to modernise platforms and deliver industry-leading solutions for customers and colleagues.

You’ll partner with business architects to translate target business processes and functions into functional components and the interactions between them, then work with solution architects and technical leads to shape delivery roadmaps and drive implementation and adoption. You’ll operate in a large, complex environment spanning legacy technologies from multiple eras, ensuring business-critical systems remain stable while new, modern components, built with open architecture, APIs and microservices, data/ML capabilities, and cloud where appropriate are introduced progressively to support Commercial Banking growth ambitions.

As an HSBC employee in the UK, you will have access to tailored professional development opportunities and a competitive pay and benefits package. This includes private healthcare for all UK-based employees, enhanced maternity and adoption pay and support when you return to work, and a contributory pension scheme with a generous employer contribution.

In This Role You’ll

 Build a thorough understanding of existing and target business functions, processes and assets  Understand how current systems/components enable those capabilities, with particular focus on problem areas  Partner with Business Architects to translate target capabilities into functional components and clear functional boundaries  Drive technical realisation of functional components, working with Solution Architects and Technical Leads to map functional components into the right UI, processing, data, and messaging designs  Engage vendors to assess suitability (or otherwise) of potential vendor components  Work with business and programme management to define implementation/adoption roadmaps that maintain service continuity and realise benefits early  Provide business knowledge to Solution/Technical Architecture and Engineering teams, and legacy systems knowledge to Business/Solution/Technical Architects  Demonstrate leadership on Regulatory & Compliance; maintain awareness of operational risk and support identification, mitigation, control and reporting 

To be successful in this role you should meet the following requirements:

 Proficient Enterprise / solution architecture including design skills with ability to produce “fit for purpose solution designs” following best practices  Ability to build high-level proposals (e.g., Clear Choice) and clearly articulate pros/cons in business terms to enable sound decisions  Skilled in analysing requirements and translating business capability into functional components and architecture  Effective graphical, written and verbal communication for both technical and non-technical stakeholders  Experience using agile methods, understanding their limitations, and knowing how to overcome them in complex environments  Experience designing/implementing highly scalable, highly available cloud services (e.g., GCP/Azure)  Breadth across modern + legacy technology stacks such as Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, API gateways (Kong), REST, Kafka, React  Familiarity with large-scale transformation using analytics and AI/ML 

Opening up a world of opportunity

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we’re dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces - no matter their gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic background or age. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. We take pride in being a Disability Confident Leader and will offer an interview to people with disabilities, long term conditions or neurodivergent candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role.

If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please get in touch with our Recruitment Helpdesk via hsbc.recruitment@hsbc.com .

rows.title: Analytical Consultant
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as an Analytical Consultant

This role would suit someone with a background in explaining business performance and recommending management actions through expert use of data analytics in a client facing role, this is a valuable opportunity to help deliver crucial business advice within our franchise-wide teamWe’ll look to you to develop processes that enable the distribution and understanding of insights into the wider bankYou’ll be supporting the business by using insights to drive effective decision making, giving you excellent recognition and the chance to raise your profile

What you'll do

This key role will see you helping to build and deliver analytics and insights for the franchise by creating and leveraging all financial and business performance including balance sheet and profit and loss (P&L). You’ll be developing and maintaining effective statistical profitability models and associated analytics, while providing actionable management information (MI) on all aspects of model performance.

As well as this, you’ll be:

Providing insight through analysis and communicating this effectively to your stakeholdersIdentifying opportunities as they arise for business strategy improvement through a range of levers such as product, propositional, target operating model, and pricingIdentifying opportunities for improvement, both in terms of the analysis being produced, and the approaches and processes used within the teamWorking with the team manager and other managers to maximise team performance and effectiveness, sharing your technical expertise to improve team capability

The skills you'll need

We’re looking for a keen problem solver who’s qualified to degree level in a numerate discipline and has data driven analysis and consulting skills. Along with extensive banking or financial services experience, you’ll have knowledge of key analytical and visualisation software. You’ll need consultancy skills, but a consultancy background is not essential.

You’ll also need:

Experience in analytical and data science including SQL, Python, and Tableau or an equivalentAn understanding of stakeholder products, propositions, customers, customer journeys, markets, and competitorsBroad experience of risk and finance systems, methodologies, and processes in a retail or wholesale banking environmentAn understanding of the regulatory regime and risk management and control processes applicable to businesses within the financial services industry

rows.title: Pricing Decision Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as a Price Decision Analyst, where you will extract meaningful insights from complex data sets, develop robust pricing and decisioning models, and provide actionable recommendations to stakeholders across multiple departments. You will play a key role in supporting, developing, maintaining, and governing pricing models, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with business standards. Using SAS-based pricing tools and advanced Excel capabilities, you will analyse pricing performance, identify opportunities for optimisation, and implement model enhancements and changes as required. This is an exciting opportunity to influence strategic pricing decisions, drive commercial outcomes, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver data-driven solutions.

To be successful as a Pricing Decision Analyst, you must have the following essential skills


Experience in coding, particularly using SAS and SQL, with a solid understanding of data mining techniques.Experience in data analytics with the ability to identify trends, draw insights, and translate analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for the business.Experience in strategic planning - contribute to and help drive commercial strategy through informed, data-led decision-making.Ability to prepare executive decision papers and presentations, and confidently present to senior stakeholders.Proven experience within Financial Services, with a good understanding of products, customer types, and associate risk considerations.


Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include


Experience supporting the development and implementation of new technical tools and capabilities.Experience in Business Banking with a considerable understanding of banking products.Background in Lending, Credit Writing, or Credit Risk assessment.Proven experience contributing to pricing decisions and working with pricing models.Experience in financial forecasting, planning, and conducting P&L (profit and loss) analysis.


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role can be based in our London, Birmingham, Knutsford, or Northampton Offices.

Purpose of the role

To extract meaningful insights from complex data sets, developing robust decision models, and presenting actionable recommendations to stakeholders across the departments.

Accountabilities


Identification and extraction of relevant data from various internal and external sources.Performing sensitivity analysis and scenario planning.Monitoring and evaluation of the performance of existing models.Development and implementation of data quality control procedures.Building and validation of quantitative models to support decision-making across different business areas.


Assistant Vice President Expectations


To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomesIf the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

rows.title: Market Data Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Join us at Barclays as a Market Data Analyst. In this role, you will join a global Market Data team operating across Glasgow and New York, supporting the management, oversight, and optimisation of Barclays' market data services and spend. You will play a key role in ensuring the effective administration of market data access, monitoring vendor services, and supporting the operational processes that underpin the firm's market data environment.

The role involves working closely with internal stakeholders, reviewing market data usage, analysing spend trends, and supporting the governance of external service providers, including oversight of market data management platforms such as Calero. This role requires a highly organised individual with strong analytical skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to work accurately within established controls and approval processes.

To be successful as a Market Data Analyst you should have:


Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships across multiple business areas.Experience working with market data, including analysing usage, spend, and trends.Advanced Excel skills, including the use of Pivot Tables and data analysis techniques.Exceptional attention to detail, particularly when reviewing invoices, validating data, and operating within approval processes.The ability to manage multiple operational tasks while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.


Some Other Highly Valued Skills/experience Include


Experience creating professional presentations using PowerPoint.Experience identifying opportunities to automate and improve operational processes.Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.


You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in the role, such as market data analysis, stakeholder management, operational effectiveness, attention to detail, problem-solving, and communication, alongside role-specific technical skills.

This role is based in Glasgow.

Purpose of the role

To partner with key stakeholders and forums to oversee Procurement service delivery, provide advice and develop procurement strategy to meet both the needs of the business and Procurement.

Accountabilities


Development & implementation of the wider Procurement strategy in collaboration with stakeholders and Procurement domains.Implementation of the procurement strategy aligned to the bank’s objectives and relevant regulators, through the prioritisation and use of Procurement resources.Provide expertise on Procurement policies and procedures, third party risk, sourcing strategy and supplier relations to business stakeholders through education.Act as a point of escalation for Procurement service and delivery issues for business stakeholders.Act as the primary interface for Procurement with senior stakeholders in the business, developing & utilising relationships and influence to deliver improvements in key indicators and objectives.Identification of & where applicable, delivery of opportunities for business cost savings, client experience, service improvement & Procurement efficiency.Voice of the business with Procurement domains, developing and utilising relationships & influence to impact Procurement service delivery.Provide insights and actionable intelligence to business stakeholders to support business decision making to improve the commercial & risk profile of the business.Support the business with strategic activity acting as the Procurement representative for key business change programmes, acquisitions and divestments.


Analyst Expectations


To meet the needs of stakeholders/ customers through specialist advice and supportPerform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard which will impact both the role itself and surrounding roles.Likely to have responsibility for specific processes within a teamThey may lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources. They supervise a team, allocate work requirements and coordinate team resources.If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.OR for an individual contributor, they manage own workload, take responsibility for the implementation of systems and processes within own work area and participate on projects broader than direct team.Execute work requirements as identified in processes and procedures, collaborating with and impacting on the work of closely related teams.Check work of colleagues within team to meet internal and stakeholder requirements.Provide specialist advice and support pertaining to own work area.Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.Maintain and continually build an understanding of how all teams in area contribute to the objectives of the broader sub-function, delivering impact on the work of collaborating teams.Continually develop awareness of the underlying principles and concepts on which the work within the area of responsibility is based, building upon administrative / operational expertise.Make judgements based on practise and previous experience.Assess the validity and applicability of previous or similar experiences and evaluate options under circumstances that are not covered by procedures.Communicate sensitive or difficult information to customers in areas related specifically to customer advice or day to day administrative requirements.Build relationships with stakeholders/ customers to identify and address their needs.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

rows.title: Director of Product, AML & Fraud Prevention
rows.descriptionText:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information About The Position

At Vinted we are devoted to making second-hand the first choice worldwide. Vinted Pay is the regulated payments entity that makes it possible through enabling Vinted users to spend money, receive money, keep money and payout, while keeping them safe from financial crime.

We are establishing a new AML & Fraud Prevention product domain within Vinted Pay. As a regulated financial institution operating across Europe, our obligations grow as we grow: anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing controls, sanctions screening, KYC, transaction monitoring are protecting our members and our balance sheet from fraud and other illegal activities. Today these capabilities sit across several teams and tools. This domain will own them end to end, and turn financial crime prevention into a mature product: controls that satisfy regulators without adding friction for the honest majority.

This is a newly created domain. As its leader you will work with your functional peers (Engineering, Data, Design) to assess the status quo and construct the long-term vision. You will be responsible for setting domain goals, delivering on already identified opportunities, hiring, and executing the product vision.

You’ll report to the leader of Engineering/Product/Design/Analytics at Vinted Pay, and partner with Product Directors across Vinted Pay and the wider marketplace, as well as with our Compliance, Legal, Risk, Risk Operations, Engineering, Design and Analytics functions.

In this position, you’ll 

Drive and align the AML & Fraud Prevention domain on a single, unified vision, expressed through measurable objectives and key resultsOwn the product roadmap across AML/CTF, sanctions and PEP screening, KYC, transaction monitoring and fraud prevention, build alignment across product teams, cross-functional partners and the leadershipPartner with our MLRO, Compliance, Risk and Legal teams to translate regulatory obligations into product requirements and make the case for automated solutions where manual controls are in placeManage multiple competing objectives and provide clarity to the delivering organisation Use and analyse data to size risk, identify product opportunities, and build the right capabilities at the right timeOwn build-vs-buy decisions, then assess and collaborate with the vendors in building and maintaining AML/Fraud prevention solutionsGet ahead of regulatory change: the EU AML package and AMLA, PSD3/PSR, evolving sanctions regimes, rather than reacting to itBuild, mentor, lead and scale a team of Product ManagersImplement best in class product development and managerial practices

About You

7+ years of experience in product management, with a substantial part of it in AML, financial crime, compliance, risk or fraud, ideally at a regulated financial institution, e-money institution, PSP, bank or fintech4+ years of developing people and managing teams, including Product ManagersDeep working knowledge of the AML domain: KYC and identity verification, customer risk scoring, sanctions and PEP screening, transaction monitoring and alert handling, SAR/STR reporting, and the regulatory frameworks behind them (EU AML directives and the AML package, national transpositions, FATF standards)Hands-on experience with fraud and scam prevention: detection models and rules engines, account takeover controls, chargebacks and disputes, and the trade-off between loss reduction and false positivesA proven track record of successful product launches (at least two substantial projects with a 6–9 month minimum duration)Comfortable operating in a regulated environment: you have worked alongside compliance officers, internal and external auditors and supervisors, and you know how to move quickly without creating regulatory exposureAble to deliver from 0 to 1, and not afraid to build your own tools to achieve your goalsExceptional leadership skills and substantial experience building high-performing teams of 10+, ideally not only in product (and we’d expect your former teams to still be singing your praises!)Significantly above-average business acumen, analytical skills and long-term planning skillsBoth quantitative and qualitative: able to assess and understand complex systems quickly, to integrate usability studies, research and market analysis into product requirements, and to be a product ambassador to the rest of the organisationWell organised, with a collaborative attitude and a strong sense of ownershipAn excellent communicator, including in written and spoken English

Work perks 

The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme25 days of paid annual leaveNewest MacBook modelsDigital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)Frequent team-building eventsHome office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furnitureLunch benefit per working dayAccess to a discounted gym membership planA personal monthly budget for shopping on VintedComprehensive Medical InsuranceGroup Life and Income Protection InsuranceA matched pension scheme up to a set limit. The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workationPension plan with the opportunity to choose your contribution percentage, and Vinted will match it up to a set limit

Working at Vinted 

Individual Learning Budget

We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.

Hybrid Work

We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.

Equal Opportunity

The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

£105,800—£143,200 GBP

rows.title: Wealth Planning Investment Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as a Wealth Planning Operations Analyst at Barclays, where you will play a key role in supporting the Wealth Planning business by ensuring the efficient progression of investment and offshore bond transactions. Working within a fast-paced operational environment, you will be responsible for maintaining agreed service levels, managing regulatory risk, and supporting business changes within the Asset Servicing control framework.

To be successful as a Wealth Planning Operations Analyst, you should have experience with:


Experience within a Wealth Planning environment.Knowledge of investment operations and associated processes.Considerable organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage competing deadlines.Experience working within a regulated and controlled environment, with a ample focus on risk and compliance.


Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include


Knowledge of Wealth Planning products and related processes.Proficiency in using Salesforce and Workforce management tools.Experience supporting operational improvements and business change activities.


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role will be based in Glasgow.

Purpose of the role

To support business areas with day-to-day processing, reviewing, reporting, trading and issue resolution.

Accountabilities


Support various business areas with day-to-day initiatives including processing, reviewing, reporting, trading, and issue resolution.Collaboration with teams across the bank to align and integrate operational processes.Identification of areas for improvement and providing recommendations in operational processes.Development and implementation of operational procedures and controls to mitigate risks and maintain operational efficiency.Development of reports and presentations on operational performance and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.Identification of industry trends and developments to implement best practice in banking operations.Participation in projects and initiatives to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.

rows.title: HR Operations & Payroll Advisor
rows.descriptionText:
The HR Operations & Payroll Advisor will play a key role in supporting the separation of BPL as it transitions to operating independently. Working as part of the HR team, the role will provide hands-on HR operational support to managers and colleagues throughout the separation, with a particular focus on HR administration, employee queries, HRIS transition, payroll and Day 1 readiness.

The HR Operations & Payroll Advisor will be a key first point of contact for HR queries, providing timely and practical support while triaging more complex or specialist matters to the relevant HR Centres of Excellence (COEs).

This is an opportunity to join a business undergoing significant transformation and to play a key role in standing up new HR infrastructure and processes, including the transition from Workday to the new HRIS and supporting payroll through the separation and dual-run period.

Key Responsibilities

To be successful as a HR Operations & Payroll Advisor, you will have experience with: 


Previous experience working in a HR Services and Payroll teamGood working knowledge of core HR processes and the employee lifecycleGood understanding of payroll processes and the ability to investigate payroll-related issuesExperience working with HRIS platforms; Workday experience is desirable for this first separation phaseStrong attention to detail, particularly when working with employee data and payrollComfortable working with spreadsheets, data validation and reconciliationExperience supporting an HRIS implementation would be advantageousComfortable working in a fast-paced, changing environment with competing priorities


You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

The successful candidate will be based in London. Our offices are located at 1 Churchill Place and 7 Westferry Circus (new BPL office). We support a hybrid working pattern with 3 days per week office-based presence expected.

Barclays’ payments acceptance business provides critical infrastructure to the UK economy, processing billions of pounds of payments annually for both small businesses and domestic and international corporate clients. 

In April 2025, we announced a long-term partnership with Brookfield Asset Management to grow and transform the payments acceptance business by broadening the range of services offered, enhancing the experience for both existing and prospective clients. Leveraging extensive client relationships and deep experience of UK payments, we will create an environment of continuous innovation - activated by Brookfield’s global private equity expertise in payments, technology, operational transformation and corporate carve-outs - to ensure the business is strategically positioned for long-term growth.

Barclays will invest approximately £400m in the new business, the majority of which will be incurred during the first three years. Performance-linked incentives will drive greater alignment between the partners, underpinning the long-term commitment to the transformation. Barclays and Brookfield will work to create a standalone entity over time, continuing to use the Barclaycard Payments (BPL) brand and acting as the sole payments acceptance services provider to Barclays’ clients for a minimum of ten years. 

For more information on our partnership with Brookfield, please visit Barclays.com.

rows.descriptionText:
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC, and fulfil your potential - whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or an exciting new direction, we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

We’re one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with a network that covers more than 50 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are seeking a Product Owner to join the Omnia programme.

This opportunity is for a finance focused Product Owner Developer to join the Omnia programme within CIB Data & Analytics. Omnia is CIB and Commercial Banking’s strategic tool for Client and Business Analytics. It is both a detailed data asset and an interactive suite of reporting and insights, providing common understanding of the value our clients generate domestically and globally, and informing client engagement, opportunity identification, and better articulation of HSBC’s network through investor disclosures.

This Product Owner Developer role will be part of the CIB Insights team. This is an end-to-end delivery team within the wider Omnia programme which builds bespoke reporting capabilities for senior use cases not serviced by the core Omnia platform. It is a vital part of the overall Omnia proposition.

As an HSBC employee in the UK, you’ll have access to tailored professional development opportunities and a competitive pay and benefits package. This includes private healthcare for all UK-based employees, enhanced maternity and adoption pay and support when you return to work, and a contributory pension scheme with a generous employer contribution.

In This Role, You Will

End-to-end ownership of technology change delivery, overseeing the full transformation and delivery lifecycle from requirements documentation and UX/UI design to development, deployment and testingPrinciple face-off to key Business stakeholders and Data teams for each deliverable, ensuring appropriate consideration of requirements and engagement throughout implementationDevelop a strong understanding of business and data structures and operations in order to translate business need into technical requirementsOwn any data analysis required to inform analytics scope and designDrive the Insights & Analytics strategy on behalf of the global leadMonitor and escalate risks, issues and dependencies as appropriate

Extensive experience delivering finance and technology transformationEnd-to-end experience of technology delivery, including requirements, testing and deployment.Highly skilled QlikSense developer, with demonstrable experience in SQL and PythonSkilled in data analysis, research, validation and documentation

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. rows.title: Central Enablement Program Lead AV
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

At Uber, delivering world-class support to our customers, earners, merchants, and partners depends on building exceptional capabilities across our global support organization.

As the Program Leader, AV Enablement , you will define and drive the enablement strategy for one of Uber's Big Bets and fastest-growing business portfolios, ensuring that enablement investments directly support business priorities and measurable outcomes. You will serve as the primary strategic partner to senior business leaders, translating evolving business needs into scalable capability solutions that improve operational performance, customer experience, and organizational readiness.

Direct experience in the autonomous vehicle (AV) or autonomous mobility industry is required for this role. The Program Leader must bring sufficient AV domain knowledge to understand the unique operational, product, safety, regulatory, partner, and customer-support considerations involved in launching and scaling AV programs.

This is a highly cross-functional leadership role requiring strategic thinking, executive stakeholder management, portfolio prioritization, and operational excellence. You will lead a team of Enablement Program Specialist(s) while partnering closely with Operations, Product, Content, Learning Design, Quality, Analytics, PMO, Learning Operations, and other global functions to deliver enablement solutions at scale.

The successful candidate thrives in ambiguity, influences without authority, and can balance long-term strategy with flawless execution in a fast-paced global environment.

Location: Phoenix

What You'll Do

 Strategic Leadership 

 Own the enablement (L&D and Quality) strategy and roadmap for a strategic business portfolio, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities.  Translate business strategy into scalable capability-building initiatives that improve business performance.  Apply AV domain expertise to anticipate launch, scaling, safety, operational-readiness, and customer-support risks, translating them into clear Enablement and Quality priorities.  Anticipate future capability needs and proactively shape enablement investments.  Establish enterprise Quality frameworks, governance models, and operating standards that evaluate capability effectiveness, operational excellence, and customer experience.  Drive continuous improvement by integrating learning, quality insights, performance data, and operational priorities into a unified enablement strategy. 

 Executive Stakeholder Management 

 Serve as the primary Enablement partner for senior business leaders.  Build trusted relationships across Operations, Product, CX, PMO, and other global functions.  Influence strategic decisions through data-driven recommendations, quality insights, and enablement expertise.  Present business reviews, quality trends, capability risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership. 

 Portfolio Management 

 Own a portfolio of complex global Enablement and Quality initiatives from strategy through execution.  Prioritize initiatives based on business impact, customer experience, operational performance, regulatory requirements, and organizational goals.  Ensure programs are delivered on time, within scope, and achieve measurable business outcomes.  Balance investments across learning transformation, quality programs, process improvement, AI adoption, and operational readiness. 

 Quality Strategy & Governance 

 Design and evolve enterprise Quality programs that drive consistent customer experiences across global operations.  Establish quality governance, audit methodologies, calibration frameworks, and performance standards.  Define Quality Scorecards, KPIs, and evaluation methodologies aligned to business and customer outcomes.  Lead quality calibration programs across regions, vendors, and internal teams to ensure consistency and fairness.  Drive root cause analysis of quality gaps and partner with Operations, Product, and Learning teams to implement systemic improvements.  Ensure quality standards support regulatory, compliance, safety, and policy requirements.  Build Voice of Customer and Voice of Business feedback loops that continuously improve operations and capability development.  Oversee quality innovation initiatives including AI-assisted evaluations, automated quality monitoring, speech analytics, and predictive quality models. 

 Team Leadership 

 Lead, coach, and develop a team of Enablement Program Specialist(s).  Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.  Provide strategic direction while enabling team autonomy and growth. 

 Enablement Strategy & Innovation 

 Drive modern enablement approaches that are scalable, reusable, data-driven, and globally consistent.  Champion innovation, experimentation, AI-enabled learning, AI-assisted quality management, and continuous improvement.  Integrate Quality insights into learning strategies to proactively address performance gaps.  Ensure learning experiences effectively close capability gaps while supporting evolving business priorities.  Drive adoption of modern enablement technologies including Learning Platforms, Knowledge Management, Quality platforms, Digital Coaching, and AI-powered enablement ecosystems. 

 Measurement & Business Impact 

 Establish success metrics and evaluation strategies for the enablement portfolio.  Leverage analytics and operational performance data to demonstrate ROI. rows.title: Sr Product Manager - Enterprise Risk
rows.descriptionText:
Senior Product Manager, Enterprise & Payment Risk

About The Role

Uber's Risk team is critical to enabling trusted growth across our global marketplace by preventing fraud and abuse while minimizing friction for legitimate users. Enterprise (B2B) accounts are a major and fast-growing part of that marketplace, and managing their risk is one of the most structurally complex domains in Payment Risk.

In this senior, high-impact individual contributor role, the Product Manager for Enterprise & Payment Risk will own the full risk lifecycle of B2B entities at scale - from onboarding and information acquisition, through manual review processes, to real-time risk decisioning at checkout and payment. The role also owns the underlying account and billing infrastructure that enterprise risk decisions run on, and the recovery/verification experiences enterprise customers rely on when something goes wrong.

A defining challenge of this role is that the enterprise customer base spans many distinct cohorts, each with a different risk tolerance and a different sensitivity to friction and actioning. Success requires calibrating risk treatment differently across these cohorts rather than applying a single, one-size-fits-all policy - balancing fraud prevention against growth and satisfaction for legitimate business customers. This is the most stakeholder-intensive scope in the Payment Risk organization, requiring close, sustained partnership with business/BD leadership in addition to Engineering, Data Science, and platform teams.

This position is ideal for a senior product leader who thrives in ambiguous, high-stakes problem spaces, has strong command of B2B/enterprise payment or billing systems, and can drive outcomes through influence across a large and often-competing set of stakeholders and shared engineering capacity.

What The Candidate Will Do

Own the B2B entity risk lifecycle end-to-end at scale: onboarding and information acquisition, manual review workflows, and real-time risk decisioning at checkout and payment.Segment and calibrate risk policy across distinct enterprise customer cohorts, each with different risk tolerance and sensitivity to friction/actioning.Define the product requirements and roadmap for enterprise risk capabilities, including underlying account and billing infrastructure modernization and its associated cross-functional dependencies.Own recovery and verification experiences for enterprise customers, including fallback challenges, admin verification, and cross-party messaging.Partner with Engineering and Data Science to scope and land payment authorization and decisioning improvements against concrete loss-reduction targets.Triage, prioritize, and negotiate a high volume of cross-functional dependency requests against shared and constrained engineering capacity.Build and maintain trusted relationships with business/BD stakeholders, translating enterprise account needs into a risk product roadmap.Measure impact using well-defined KPIs (e.g., loss-rate reduction, authorization effectiveness, dispute/chargeback rates) and iterate based on learnings.Coordinate with Risk Operations, Risk Governance/Compliance, and payments platform teams to ensure solutions are practical, compliant, and operationally sound.

Basic Qualifications

8+ years of product management experience delivering software products as an individual contributor in a technology company.Experience owning a complex, technically deep product domain (e.g., payments, billing, risk, or platform infrastructure) with significant stakeholder breadth.Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to inform decisions and measure impact.Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex problems simply to both technical and business audiences.Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Engineering, Data Science, Business/BD, Design, and Operations, including negotiating priority against shared/constrained resources.Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data/Analytics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent experience).

Preferred Qualifications

Risk & Fraud Domain Expertise - Experience in risk, fraud, or trust & safety within a B2B/enterprise or multi-sided marketplace, particularly billing risk, checkout/payment decisioning, or auth-hold systems.B2B/Enterprise Product Ownership - Prior ownership of a product serving business or organizational accounts (rather than purely consumer-facing products), including billing configuration, credit management, or account administration.Business Acumen - Demonstrated ability to drive P&L improvements through loss reduction or account-health initiatives, with strong intuition for how risk interventions affect the broader business.Strategic Judgment - Strong product instincts for navigating ambiguous, structurally complex problem spaces and balancing competing constraints across risk, business, engineering capacity, and compliance.Advanced Business Education - MBA or equivalent business experience.

Extra notes:

Prefer candidates with prior experience in engineering, data scientist, consulting, finance, or a B2B/enterprise SaaS product role before moving into PM, given the domain's billing/payments complexity.
