rows.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Our Opportunity

The Inbound Technology and Data Science team is an integral part of Chewy’s Operations Technology organization. Our team builds the products and science-based capabilities that maintain a healthy flow of inbound volume across Chewy’s 13 core fulfillment centers, ensuring our network has the right inventory and labor in place to serve pet parents.

We are seeking a Senior Technical Product Manager to define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Chewy’s inbound planning products. This role will lead the evolution of our 13-week planning process from manually coordinated workflows toward scalable, automated, and science-based solutions.

This highly visible and cross-functional role will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Replenishment, Transportation, In Stock, and Fulfillment Center Operations teams. You will be responsible for ensuring that the ecosystem of inbound products and teams works together effectively to support near-term operational needs and Chewy’s long-term growth. The ideal candidate is a clear communicator and trusted partner who uses data to influence decisions, align senior leaders, and translate complex supply chain challenges into scalable technical solutions.

What You’ll Do

Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Chewy’s inbound planning capabilities, with a focus on automation, scalability, and science-based decision-making.Own the technical products supporting the 13-week inbound planning process across Chewy’s 13 core fulfillment centers.Identify opportunities to innovate and improve how inbound volume, labor, inventory, capacity, and operational constraints are planned across the fulfillment network.Partner with engineering and data science teams to translate complex business and operational needs into clear product requirements, technical capabilities, and use cases.Work alongside engineering and data science throughout the development lifecycle to scope, test, launch, and continuously improve inbound planning solutions.Coordinate across Replenishment, Transportation, In Stock, and Fulfillment Center Operations teams, including both business and technology partners, to align roadmaps, manage dependencies, and ensure the broader product ecosystem works together effectively.Build trust with stakeholders by using data to frame problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and drive clear and objective decisions.Influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners to establish shared priorities and alignment on inbound planning strategies.Define and track key performance indicators that measure planning quality, network health, operational efficiency, and product impact.Develop clear product documentation, including vision documents, roadmaps, business requirements, user stories, and leadership updates.Identify risks and dependencies early, establish mitigation plans, and communicate changes or tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders.Stay current on emerging technologies and industry trends in supply chain planning, automation, optimization, and data science to inform product strategy and drive innovation.

What You’ll Need

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Research, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.5+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager or in a comparable product role, owning and driving complex technical roadmaps from strategy through execution.Demonstrated experience translating complex business and operational challenges into scalable technical products and clear requirements.Proven ability to develop product vision documents, roadmaps, business requirements, user stories, epics, and use cases and to work effectively with agile development teams.Experience partnering closely with engineering and data science teams throughout product discovery, development, testing, launch, and iteration.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data to generate insights, evaluate tradeoffs, and influence decisions.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical and operational concepts for senior leaders and diverse cross-functional audiences.Demonstrated ability to build trust, influence without direct authority, and drive alignment across teams with competing priorities.Experience managing dependencies across multiple products, systems, teams, and operational workflows.Passion for building products that improve operational efficiency, decision quality, scalability, and customer outcomes.

Bonus

Experience building or managing supply chain planning, inbound logistics, inventory, transportation, labor planning, or fulfillment technology products.Experience using SQL and data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI to analyze performance and support product decisions.Familiarity with data science and optimization techniques, including forecasting, simulation, machine learning, and scheduling or network optimization algorithms.Understanding of distributed systems, APIs, cloud computing, and microservices architectures.Experience developing products that replace manual planning processes with automated, data-driven decision-making.

What You’ll Get

A place where you can be your authentic self and grow your career. Our pet parents and partners are from everywhere—different places and different walks of life. It is what makes them unique. Likewise, Chewtopians are encouraged to bring their perspectives to deliver on our mission!Work in a culture that cares, with managers who value you and your career journey. Be empowered to think big, thrive on delivering results, and become your best.Opportunities to develop meaningful connections with a diverse group of Chewtopians through Team Member Resource Groups and to celebrate inclusivity through company events, programs, and activities.Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, in addition to wellness programs and resources that enable you to be your best self in and outside of work.

The base salary range for this role is $141,000 - $225,000.00.

The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, education, and work location. In addition, this position is eligible for 401k and a new hire and annual equity grant. C08+ positions may also be eligible for annual bonus.

We offer different types of insurance and benefits, such as medical/Rx, vision, dental, life, disability, hospital indemnity, critical illness, and accident. We offer parental leave, family services benefits, backup dependent care, flexible spending accounts, telemedicine, pet adoption reimbursement, employee assistance program, and many discounts including 10% off pet insurance and 20% off at Chewy.com.

Exempt salary team members have unlimited PTO, subject to manager approval. Team members will receive six paid holidays per year. Team members may be eligible for paid sick and family leave in compliance with applicable state and local regulations.

Chewy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, citizenship, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, results of genetic testing, veteran status, as well as any other legally-protected characteristic. If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar law, and you need an accommodation during the application process or to perform these job requirements, or if you need a religious accommodation, please contact CAAR@chewy.com.

Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. Job Overview

The Manager, Workforce Administration leads a team of Workforce Administration professionals responsible for supporting workforce planning, position management, organizational maintenance, workforce reporting, and HR administrative processes. This role ensures the accuracy, integrity, and governance of workforce data while driving operational excellence across workforce administration functions.

The Manager coaches and develops a high-performing team, establishes efficient processes, monitors service delivery and quality standards, and partners with leaders across Human Resources, Workforce Management, Finance, Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, and business teams. This leader provides strategic direction, identifies opportunities for process improvement, and drives initiatives that enhance workforce data accuracy, organizational effectiveness, and the colleague experience.

The Manager, Workforce Administration is responsible for hiring, training, coaching, and developing hourly and/or professional colleagues while fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and customer-focused service.

What You Will Do

Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, training resources, and quality controls to ensure consistency and scalability across the function.Manage departmental projects and strategic initiatives that support organizational growth, workforce optimization, and business objectives. Workforce Administration Expertise: Strong understanding of workforce planning, position management, organizational structures, workforce reporting, data governance, and HR operational processes.

Analytical & Data-Driven Decision Making: Ability to analyze workforce metrics, identify trends, develop insights, and make informed business recommendations.

Problem-Solving: Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to investigate complex issues, evaluate risks, and implement effective solutions.

Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and present information to leaders at all levels.

Collaboration & Relationship Building: Ability to build strong cross-functional partnerships and effectively navigate a matrixed organizational environment.

Process Improvement: Experience identifying inefficiencies and implementing scalable process improvements that enhance service delivery and operational performance.

Technical Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, workforce management tools, HRIS platforms, reporting systems, and data analysis tools.

Adaptability: Ability to effectively manage competing priorities and lead through organizational change in a fast-paced environment.

Who You Are

Lead with integrity, accountability, and inclusiveness.Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, and continuous feedback.Foster a culture of innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.Drive engagement and create an environment where colleagues feel valued, respected, and empowered to succeed.Champion collaboration across teams to deliver exceptional business and colleague outcomes.

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. rows.title: Principal Software Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
POS-5690

About The Team

The Observability team owns the internal platform that gives every HubSpot engineer real visibility into how their systems behave in production. We build and operate the distributed tracing, metrics, alerting, and logging infrastructure that spans hundreds of microservices, billions of daily events, and thousands of engineers who depend on that signal to ship reliably.

We are now investing in the next generation of this platform. As HubSpot deploys AI agents and ML-powered features across the product, the team is building the tracing and telemetry primitives that make it possible to understand, debug, and trust what those systems are doing in production. This is greenfield, technically interesting work at a scale few companies operate at and we are looking for a Principal Engineer to help lead it.

About The Role

We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer to be the technical anchor for HubSpot’s Observability platform. This role sits at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems, developer platform design, and AI observability. A big part of this role is working horizontally across a large engineering org and setting patterns and standards that make it easier for teams to instrument, alert on, and reason about their services. You will also shape how we trace and understand our growing fleet of AI agents and ML systems in production: a technically distinct and increasingly critical problem.

Key Expectations

Observability Platform Architecture: Define the patterns and evolution of HubSpot’s core telemetry platform — distributed tracing, metrics, and structured logging — at a scale that spans hundreds of services and billions of daily events. Set the standards for how instrumentation is done across a large, polyglot engineering organization.AI & Agentic Observability: Lead the technical strategy for tracing and understanding AI agents and ML-powered systems in production. Define the primitives, telemetry standards, and debugging workflows that help product engineers understand what their models and agents are doing — and build trust in those systems over time. This is greenfield and consequential work.High-Cardinality, High-Throughput Systems: Architect telemetry pipelines and storage systems that handle high-cardinality data at high throughput without blowing up cost or query latency. Make principled tradeoffs between sampling, fidelity, retention, and developer ergonomics.Hands-on, High-Leverage Builder: Ship production code. Lead design reviews and take high-impact initiatives end-to-end, from prototype to production system at scale. Stay close to the systems you build and be the person who can debug the hardest problems when they surface.Developer Experience & Adoption: Design the instrumentation APIs and libraries that product engineers reach for, making correct observability the path of least resistance. Drive OpenTelemetry adoption across a large, polyglot codebase. Build the tooling that turns raw telemetry into actionable signal for teams operating at speed.Production Intelligence & Reliability Patterns: Define patterns for SLO/SLI design, alerting philosophy, and how teams graduate from reactive to proactive incident response. Push for simplicity in a domain that wants to get complicated, and consistency where tooling can drift across a large organization.Technical Leadership & Influence: Partner with infrastructure, platform, and product engineering teams to understand their signal gaps and close them. Influence technical strategy alongside engineering leadership, translating observability constraints and opportunities into product and operational decisions. Mentor senior engineers and tech leads, driving thoughtful design decisions and capturing learnings from major incidents and large-scale migrations.

What You Bring

Platform-Builder Experience: Proven experience building observability or telemetry tooling for internal engineering teams, rather than simply consuming it. You understand how to architect developer platforms that serve thousands of engineers across a large organization, backed by deep operational instincts and hard-earned expertise.Telemetry Systems Depth: Deep expertise navigating trade-offs in telemetry pipeline design across high-cardinality data, dynamic sampling, query latency, retention economics, and data fidelity. Strong technical fluency with OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing engines, metric backends, and large-scale log ingestion infrastructure.Incident Automation & Operational Excellence: Proven track record linking telemetry signals directly to automated operational workflows. You have designed architecture for real-time telemetry triggers that power automated remediation, dynamic runbooks, or AI-assisted root-cause diagnosis across microservices environments.

Why This Role, Why Now

HubSpot is scaling fast — more engineers, more microservices, more AI systems running in production — and the Observability platform is at an inflection point. The foundations are solid, but the next phase requires a different kind of investment: rethinking cardinality economics, making OpenTelemetry the default across a large polyglot org, and building an entirely new layer of AI tracing that doesn’t yet exist.

This Principal Engineer will have a direct line of sight from the architecture they design to the engineering outcomes we measure: incident response times, adoption rates, developer satisfaction, and the trust that product teams place in their production signal. The AI observability layer in particular is greenfield — there is no playbook to follow, which is exactly what makes this the right moment for the right person.

If you want to build the platform that helps thousands of engineers understand what their systems are doing — including systems powered by AI that are genuinely hard to see inside — this is the role.

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. Learn more about HubSpot’s compensation philosophy.

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

Annual Cash Compensation Range

$313,800—$502,080 USD

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

rows.title: Senior Architect, Corporate Systems
rows.descriptionText:
Our Culture and Impact

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500+ employees and ~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

Corporate Systems is Cvent’s internal business application platform, responsible for designing, building, and operating the systems that power how revenue is captured, cash moves, people are supported, and data flows across the company. Our core corporate system platforms include Salesforce (Sales, Service, CPQ, Experience Cloud), Oracle EBS, Snowflake, Informatica, Sigma, UiPath, Coupa, Concur, Certinia, and Intellievent, along with adjacencies such as HighRadius, Kyriba, Safebooks.AI, Marketo, 6sense, Gainsight, Staircase, Chorus, Gong, Nice InContact, and ZoomInfo. We operate nine sub-functions and run simultaneous transformation programs — and as a serial acquirer, maintain a consistent, scalable playbook for Post-Merger System Integration (PMI) — each with direct impact on revenue, customer experience, and financial integrity.

We are hiring a Corporate Systems Architect to provide the architectural leadership this complexity demands — setting the standards, patterns, and technical direction that enable our teams and partners to design, build, and scale with consistency and confidence across our application estate, data landscape, and AI capabilities.

Define and steward enterprise architecture

Own the target-state architecture across our core corporate system platforms — Salesforce (Sales, Service, CPQ, Experience Cloud), Oracle EBS, Snowflake, Informatica, Sigma, UiPath, Coupa, Concur, Certinia, and Intellievent, along with adjacencies such as HighRadius, Kyriba, Safebooks.AI, Marketo, 6sense, Gainsight, Staircase, Chorus, Gong, Nice InContact, and ZoomInfo — ensuring a coherent, well-governed, and future-ready platform estate.Establish Cvent’s architectural paved road — reusable reference patterns across experience, integration, data, AI, and security that empower delivery teams and partners to design and scale with confidence. Define data contracts, cross-system impact assessment, and how quality and resilience are built in as enduring principles.

Lead AI architecture and the agentic framework

Own the AI orchestration and agentic framework — connecting Agentforce agents, Snowflake Cortex models, semantic layers, and business rules into a governed, production-ready ecosystem across the enterprise application estate.Architect AI-enabled solutions across the Lead-to-Cash lifecycle — including Agentforce Account Summary and Next Best Action, conversational analytics agents, PS intelligent automation, and AI-driven financial governance — with data privacy and responsible AI governance embedded from the outset in partnership with the AI Governance Council and the broader IT organization including InfoSec.

Shape Lead-to-Cash architecture across PLG, SLG, and M&A

Own the end-to-end Lead-to-Cash architecture — how leads are qualified and progressed, commercial terms configured, and orders, subscriptions, overages, and revenue flows modelled and governed across Salesforce CPQ, Oracle EBS, Stripe/Chargebee, Snowflake, and Gainsight — underpinning revenue integrity and financial reporting.Architect PLG and SLG convergence for acquired organizations as we execute PMI — delivering repeatable, documented approaches that accelerate time-to-value with each acquisition.

Own data and integration architecture with Data Governance

Define master data architecture for Accounts, Contacts, Subscriptions, Contracts, Products, and Financials — establishing systems of record and data contracts across Salesforce, EBS, CVII, Marketo, and Snowflake. Partner closely with the Data Governance function to embed quality, stewardship, and lineage into platform design from the outset.Set integration design standards governing pipeline architecture, schema change management, resilience patterns, and entitlement management. Collaborate with Analytics and CloudOps to advance Snowflake as the enterprise intelligence platform for analytics, BI, and AI workloads.

Lead governance, provide the architecture framework, and build the community

Serve as architecture owner for transformation programs across Corporate Systems and Cvent, the overall AI portfolio, and M&A — providing the architecture framework of standards, patterns, review processes, and decision criteria that enables architects across CRM, Oracle, Snowflake, and integration domains to operate with autonomy and scale their work.Drive design review (ARB) across teams and external partners. Act as trusted advisor to VP IT, CIO, and business leaders. Work closely with architects already embedded across CRM, Oracle, and Snowflake environments — co-owning direction, raising collective standards, and contributing to talent strategy as the architecture community grows.15-20+ years in enterprise or corporate systems architecture, owning large-scale CRM, ERP, and data platform transformations in complex, global B2B environments.Deep, hands-on Salesforce expertise: Sales, Service, CPQ, Experience Cloud — Apex, integration patterns, security model, org design, and Agentforce configuration and governance.Solid Oracle EBS knowledge: GL, AR/AP, billing and revenue flows, and the patterns connecting Salesforce commercial data to EBS invoicing, revenue recognition, and financial controls.Meaningful Snowflake architecture experience — schema design, semantic and data contract layers, Cortex and AI capabilities, and how DWH design choices shape analytics and AI workloads.Integration and MDM depth with Informatica or comparable platforms (MuleSoft, Boomi, Tray) and a strong understanding of resilient, observable pipeline architecture across complex application landscapes.Practical experience designing agentic architectures — LLM grounding and retrieval, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop design, and governance frameworks that scale across an enterprise.The ability to build architecture frameworks that enable distributed teams to make consistent, high-quality design decisions — and to communicate trade-offs clearly to Finance, CS, and RevOps leaders.Proven Senior Director track record owning cross-functional programs and influencing senior stakeholders. Salesforce Architect certifications strongly preferred. Snowflake, Oracle EBS, TOGAF a plus.

What Success Looks Like (12-24 Months)

A North Star architecture for Corporate Systems — spanning transformation programs, Lead-to-Cash, the AI portfolio, and M&A — actively used as the authoritative reference by delivery teams and partners.An architecture framework in place that enables architects across CRM, Oracle, Snowflake, and integration domains to make consistent, high-quality design decisions independently and at scale.A governed AI and agentic architecture with high-impact solutions in production across the Lead-to-Cash lifecycle, with clear data contracts, observable behavior, and measurable business outcomes.A Corporate Systems architecture community recognized for technical depth, shared design culture, and a consistently high standard of quality across all sub-functions and programs.

rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About EBay Live

eBay Live is eBay’s interactive live shopping experience where sellers and creators stream in real time and buyers engage through chat, bidding, and instant purchases. It blends entertainment, community, and commerce into a dynamic, trust‑backed way to discover and shop. Join us to build the analytics and AI backbone that powers discovery, engagement, and quality moderation across Live. It’s a high‑visibility, priority growth initiative with significant runway - an opportunity to deliver measurable impact at marketplace scale.

Opportunity

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will independently operate as a trusted Analytics Thought Partner for a specific eBay Live pillar - leading moderate‑to‑complex analyses end‑to‑end, actively engaging stakeholders, resolving ambiguous problems, and prioritizing the most impactful work.

Specifically you will be part of the journey to build the Data Science engine powering eBay Live hyper‑growth across pillars such as Seller Product and Success, Buyer Product, Categories/Markets expansion, Trust & Safety, Data Foundation, and Business Performance; and to deliver measurable impact in product strategy, growth, and marketplace efficiency through causal measurement, experimentation, marketplace and risk modeling, and production‑grade insights/dashboards.

What You’ll Do

You Will Focus On One Of The Following Pillars

Buyer Product Analytics: Lead end‑to‑end analyses for live commerce features; define product metrics; build dashboards; run experiments that inform the roadmap and growth. Choose appropriate methods and operate with minimal guidance.Seller Product & Seller Success: Design growth experiments; analyze onboarding, listing quality, conversion, and retention; propose interventions; track impact with rigorous measurement and reporting.Categories & Markets Expansion: Model category–market dynamics; size opportunities; build selection/expansion frameworks; recommend sequencing and launch decisions; contribute lightweight data engineering (e.g., derived tables) to unblock analyses.Trust & Safety: Analyze marketplace risk signals; partner on guardrail design and monitoring; apply practical ML/AI; refine test designs and metrics to reduce false positives while preserving good‑actor experience.Data Foundation & Instrumentation: Clarify metric taxonomies; ensure instrumentation quality; build curated datasets and dashboards; troubleshoot data issues; automate recurring tasks with a product‑first mindset.Business Performance: Own KPIs within scope; synthesize daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly performance narratives; surface opportunities/risks; influence decisions with evidence‑based recommendations and audience‑appropriate storytelling.


What You Bring

Advanced analytics and causal inference (uplift, diff‑in‑diff, CUPED), robust A/B test design, and strong judgment in method selection for ambiguous problems.Technical toolkit: SQL/Python, dashboarding (e.g., Tableau/Looker), familiarity with applied ML/AI, and the ability to optimize queries and contribute lightweight data engineering when necessary.Quality and rigor: Proactive assumption checks, validation, and troubleshooting; ability to scale insights via self‑serve dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actually use.Communication and storytelling: Clear narratives that explain the “so what”; adjust depth for technical vs. non‑technical audiences; confident presentation and on‑the‑fly Q&A in cross‑functional forums.Stakeholder engagement: Proactive partner management; serve as the primary analytics contact for your area; propose data‑driven opportunities beyond explicit requests; consult managers for guidance in high‑stakes discussions as needed.Emerging leadership: Lead analyses coordinating with others; mentor junior analysts on technical skills and domain; demonstrate ownership and reliability in delivery and outcomes.


Qualifications

BS/MS in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Economics, CS) or equivalent experience; 4-7 years in analytics/data science with demonstrated end‑to‑end delivery on moderate‑to‑complex projects.Strong SQL/Python; experimentation design; statistical modeling; dashboarding; familiarity with marketplace dynamics and product analytics.Executive‑ready communication with the ability to distill complex analysis to actionable recommendations and influence product decisions.


Additional Details

$149,200 - $199,200

The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). rows.title: AI Architect
rows.descriptionText:
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500+ employees and ~30,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues, and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, take risks, and make decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

The AI Architect will be responsible for designing, building, and optimizing the systems and AI-powered infrastructure that drives the autonomous customer journey for client services. This role demands a hands-on technologist with deep experience architecting and implementing AI solutions—someone who writes code, builds integrations, and ships working systems, not just frameworks. You will drive cross-functional alignment by serving as the key liaison among Engineering, CDP, IT, and the Tech PMO teams—ensuring seamless project execution, clear communication, and timely delivery of critical initiatives. This role reports to the Vice President of Enterprise Services.

Systems Architecture: Architect and implement the systems infrastructure underpinning client services platforms—designing for reliability, scalability, and security across all customer touchpoints. Own technical decisions end-to-end, from architecture to working code.Business Impact Measurement: Define and track key metrics to measure the impact of AI and systems initiatives on business outcomes such as CSAT, onboarding speed, efficiency, and cost reduction. Tie engineering decisions directly to measurable ROI.Instrumentation & Data Capture: Collaborate with engineering and product teams to ensure comprehensive instrumentation in the codebase, capturing all relevant client interaction and operational data for actionable insights.Process Orchestration & System Integration: Lead process orchestration initiatives, integrating and optimizing workflows across platforms such as Rudderstack, Salesforce, Gainsight, Avaamo, and Staircase AI. Demonstrate expertise in integrating systems so that user segmentation flows seamlessly from Customer Data Platform (CDP) to Product Experience (PX), enabling curated, personalized experiences at every step.AI/ML Solution Integration: Hands-on design, implementation, and deployment of AI-driven solutions for support automation, customer health scoring, and workflow optimization. You will write the code, build the integrations, and own the systems—not just evaluate vendors or manage others who do.AI & Systems Implementation: Design and build scalable AI-powered systems and pipelines that enable real-time insights, proactive interventions, and personalized client experiences. Hands-on coding is expected—this is a builder role.Custom Design & Development: Write production-quality code (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar) to build and ship AI-powered features, integrations, and tooling. Comfortable owning implementations from prototype through deployment.Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the hands-on technical authority for AI systems, process automation, and platform architecture within Client Services, leading by doing as much as by guiding.Best Practices & Governance: Establish and enforce engineering best practices for AI systems, including testing, observability, and responsible AI governance across client services.Proven experience (10+ years) in systems architecture, software engineering, and AI implementation, ideally within a SaaS or technology-driven environment.Hands-on software engineering skills with a strong track record of building and deploying AI/ML systemsAdvanced technical engineering and data science skills, including hands-on experience with data modeling, APIs, workflow automation, and AI/ML integration. Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript required.Deep understanding of distributed systems, APIs, event-driven architecture, and instrumentation best practices.Demonstrated experience with modern client services, technology stacks, and AI platforms (e.g., chatbots, customer intelligence, workflow automation).Proven track record of implementing complicated integrationsProficiency in scripting and backend languages (Python preferred); frontend experience (HTML/CSS/JS) a plus but not the focus of this role.Proven ability to integrate systems to enable user segmentation and curated experiences from CDP to Gainsight PX.Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process optimization abilities.Ability to translate business needs into scalable, high-impact technical solutions that deliver measurable ROI.Experience working with cross-functional teams and managing multi-stakeholder projects.Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across the organization.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

About the Team

You will be a key member of the Supply Chain Product Management team responsible for delivering technology capabilities that modernize and optimize Williams-Sonoma's end-to-end supply chain. The team partners closely with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Merchandising, Engineering, Architecture, Analytics, and Technology to deliver scalable product capabilities that improve operational efficiency, inventory productivity, manufacturing performance, and customer experience. You will be a key member of the Supply Chain Product Management team that is responsible for continuous improvement of our supply chain by focusing on removing friction points for our internal and external customers by delivering a highly satisfying experience.

About The Role

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is in the business of enhancing the quality of our customers' lives at home. This critical Principal Product Manager role owns the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for Williams-Sonoma's Manufacturing technology domain, supporting our in-house furniture and lighting manufacturing operations. This leader will define and deliver capabilities that improve manufacturing planning, production execution, inventory visibility, quality, scheduling, materials management, shop floor operations, and fulfillment while enabling scalable growth across our manufacturing network. This role operates across strategy and execution, partnering with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Technology leaders to define product strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver measurable business outcomes across Williams-Sonoma's manufacturing network. The right candidate will have deep experience with discrete manufacturing as well as the associated logistics and transportation activities and a techno-functional / Product Management background.

Responsibilities


This role operates across product strategy and execution, partnering with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Technology leaders to modernize manufacturing capabilities and deliver measurable business outcomes across Williams-Sonoma's manufacturing network.Own the Manufacturing product strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities, identifying opportunities through customer insights, operational data, and hypothesis-driven product discovery focused on measurable business outcomes.Monitor emerging manufacturing, supply chain, ERP, AI, and digital manufacturing trends, evaluating new technologies and industry practices that can improve Williams-Sonoma's competitive advantage.Define product success metrics and measurement plans tied to manufacturing efficiency, production throughput, inventory accuracy, schedule adherence, quality, operational productivity, adoption, and business value realization. Continuously measure outcomes to guide product investment decisions and optimization.Lead product discovery, business process analysis, and solution definition for manufacturing capabilities, translating business needs into product strategy, roadmaps, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized Jira backlogs that enable iterative Agile delivery.Identify, prioritize, and deliver AI-enabled capabilities that improve manufacturing planning, shop floor productivity, quality, scheduling, operational efficiency, and business decision making while leveraging generative AI to improve product discovery, requirements quality, documentation, and team productivity.Serve as the primary product leader across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Engineering, Architecture, and Technology teams, aligning stakeholders around product vision, priorities, delivery, and measurable business value.Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams to deliver iterative product capabilities using Agile methodologies while balancing business value, technical debt, scalability, and long-term platform health.Serve as the manufacturing product subject matter expert, leading cross-functional exploration, making informed product recommendations, and communicating roadmap priorities, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes to business partners and senior Technology leadership.Lead organizational readiness and product adoption activities, including stakeholder alignment, business process design, SOP documentation, training, UAT, hyper-care, and adoption measurement.Ensure manufacturing solutions meet governance, security, audit, licensing, and compliance requirements while partnering with Internal Audit and Technology teams to establish appropriate operational controls.


Criteria


10 years of Product Management or techno-functional experience supporting Manufacturing, Supply Chain, ERP, or related enterprise technology platforms.Experience with discrete manufacturing, configurable products, production planning, bills of material, routings, work centers, capacity planning, quality management, and manufacturing execution preferred.Demonstrated ability to influence senior business and technology leaders, drive executive alignment, manage competing priorities, and communicate effectively across executive, operational, and technical audiences without direct authority.Deep understanding of Microsoft Dynamics AX/Dynamics 365 Manufacturing, Supply Chain Management, Production Control, Inventory Management, Procurement, Warehouse Management, and related manufacturing processes.Demonstrated experience owning product strategy, roadmaps, and execution for complex enterprise platforms supporting manufacturing or supply chain operations.Own the product lifecycle from discovery through adoption, continuously measuring business outcomes and incorporating customer feedback into future roadmap priorities.Experience applying AI, generative AI, machine learning, automation, or advanced analytics to improve manufacturing operations, product management practices, or business processes. Demonstrated ability to identify and deliver AI-enabled business capabilities.Experience with related supply chain operations, order management, eCommerce and finance / accounting processes.Experience leading large-scale business transformation initiatives from product discovery through implementation, including business process redesign, organizational change management, UAT, training, and production adoption.Experience with the process of configurable products as they flow from the eCommerce customer’s orders through order management (OMS) and to Dynamics 365 for manufacturing and order fulfillment.You have a proven ability to understand and discuss technical concepts, manage difficult tradeoffs, and evaluate new ideas with partners across the organization.Experience in a large, multi-brand business preferred. Consulting experience is also desirable.Experience creating and managing product backlogs, including writing epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritizing work within Jira for Agile software delivery.Strong communication and negotiation skills and the ability to lead and influence others.Bachelor's degree or more in Engineering, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field or equivalent work experience. This role requires being onsite in the WSI manufacturing Claremont, North Carolina office Monday through Thursday.Some travel will be required to other WSI manufacturing and supply chain locations within the United States. (Manufacturing: Claremont, NC; Tupelo, MS; Portland, OR)


Our Culture & Values

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits


A generous discount on all WSI brandsA 401(k) plan and other investment opportunitiesPaid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteerHealth benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefitsTax-free commuter benefitsA wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health


Continued Learning


In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI UniversityCross-brand and cross-function career opportunities Resources for self-developmentAdvisor (Mentor) programCareer development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series 


This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances.

About Us

Our Company

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark & Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick-and-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

Role Purpose

As a People Director, you will be a strategic partner to the leadership team, helping to shape and deliver the people agenda across a large, complex attraction or region within Merlin. You will play a critical role in aligning business goals with people strategies, building leadership capability, driving organisational effectiveness, and creating an inclusive, high-performing culture.

Working closely with senior leaders, you will provide insight, challenge, and support to ensure our people strategy translates into meaningful business outcomes. You'll influence change, develop talent, strengthen employee engagement, and help create an environment where our teams can thrive.

What You'll Be Responsible For Strategic People Partnership 

 Partner with senior leadership teams to align people priorities with business objectives.  Translate commercial goals into workforce and talent plans that drive performance.  Provide strategic advice on organisational design, workforce planning, and change initiatives.  Use people insights and data to inform decision-making and identify opportunities for improvement. 

 Leadership & Talent Development 

 Coach and support leaders to build high-performing, accountable, and inclusive teams.  Lead talent and succession planning to ensure strong pipelines for current and future business needs.  Partner with specialist teams to strengthen leadership capability and employee development.  Champion a culture of continuous learning, growth, and performance excellence. 

 Change & Organizational Effectiveness 

 Lead and support organizational change initiatives, ensuring successful adoption and sustainable outcomes.  Embed new ways of working that improve agility, collaboration, and decision-making.  Drive workforce planning and organizational effectiveness initiatives that support operational goals. 

 Employee Engagement & Culture 

 Partner with leaders to develop engagement strategies that improve the employee experience.  Leverage employee feedback and insights to identify priorities and implement meaningful actions.  Promote Merlin's employer brand internally and externally, helping attract and retain exceptional talent.  Foster an inclusive culture where colleagues feel valued, respected, and empowered. 

 Reward, Recognition & Inclusion 

 Support the delivery of reward and recognition programmes, ensuring fair and consistent processes.  Embed pay equity principles and recognition strategies within the business.  Translate diversity, equity and inclusion strategies into impactful local initiatives.  Partner with leaders to create a workplace where everyone can belong and succeed. 

 Operational Excellence 

 Use people analytics and workforce insights to measure impact and inform future priorities.  Ensure compliance with employment legislation and Merlin policies.  Partner with shared services and specialist teams to deliver a seamless employee experience.  Lead complex employee relations matters and provide expert guidance to leaders on sensitive cases. 

Qualifications & Experience

 Experience 

 Significant experience partnering with senior operational leaders in a strategic HR or People Partnering role.  Strong background in talent management, organisational development, workforce planning, and change management.  Experience influencing and delivering results within complex, matrixed organisations.  Proven ability to manage complex employee relations matters and stakeholder relationships.  Experience supporting diverse and geographically dispersed teams. 

 Skills & Capability 

 Strong commercial awareness and the ability to connect people strategies to business outcomes.  Exceptional stakeholder management, coaching, and influencing skills.  Excellent analytical capability with experience using data and insights to drive decisions.  Strong communication skills with the ability to engage audiences at all levels.  Highly collaborative, adaptable, and solutions-focused.  Passion for developing people and creating inclusive, high-performing cultures. 

 Success in This Role 

The Successful People Director Will

 Build trusted relationships with senior leaders.  Drive measurable improvements in engagement, leadership capability, and organisational performance.  Develop strong talent pipelines and succession plans.  Successfully lead and support strategic business change.  Create an inclusive and high-performing culture that enables our people and business to thrive. 

 Our Leadership Expectations 

At Merlin, Our Leaders Are

 Soulfully Curious 

Always learning, seeking different perspectives, and exploring new possibilities.

 Results Focused 

Setting clear priorities, taking accountability, and delivering meaningful outcomes.

 Extraordinary Teammates 

Collaborating across teams, sharing expertise, and supporting the success of others.

 Developers of People 

Creating opportunities for growth, coaching talent, and helping others achieve their potential.

This is an opportunity to shape the future of our people strategy while making a meaningful impact on the success of the business and the experience of our employees.

Benefits

We’re growing fast and alongside a fun and friendly environment, we offer a fabulous package and amazing prospects – ideal if you’re already fantastic and want to become even better (our magic can help here). Benefits include Pension, Life Assurance, discretionary company bonus, 33 days’ holiday including bank holidays, a Merlin Magic Pass which gives you and your friends and family free admission to all of our attractions worldwide, an Enjoy the Ride pass which entitles you and 5 loved ones unlimited entry into your regional attractions, 25% discount in our retail shops and restaurants and 40% discount on LEGO, plus lots more!

Description & Requirements

The Bloomberg Terminal quickly and accurately delivers business and financial information, news and insight around the world to over 315,000 customers worldwide. Our global terminal customers depend on our proprietary high-quality hardware to be able to access our terminal and make critical business decisions.

Bloomberg's Global Finance team works with all things (you guessed it) ! We help business partners with all aspects of Procurement to cash collection, customer billing, revenue recording, vendor invoice processing and payments, regional treasury, and cash funding, indirect tax, capital planning and fixed assets. Global Procurement supports both the strategic sourcing and operational purchasing of goods and services for the organization. What does that mean? We procure and distribute the goods and services that Bloomberg needs to do business. We handle any vendor-related risks and deliver the best customer service in the world.

We understand urgency, work hard, have commercial acumen and are customer service driven. Our clients internally and externally count on us daily. Our team is tight, but our culture is wide open, where we challenge and support each other's creative ideas to remain first-class.

The Role

Bloomberg's Global Procurement team is seeking a Responsible Procurement Lead to lead the continued development and delivery of our Responsible Procurement agenda. This role will partner closely with Bloomberg's Corporate Sustainability team and cross-functional partners across Procurement, Legal, Vendor Risk Management, Engineering and Workplace Sustainability to embed environmental, social and governance (ESG) considerations throughout the supplier lifecycle.

Responsible Procurement at Bloomberg means integrating ESG parameters into procurement decisions, practices and planning while maintaining a balanced focus on cost, quality, service, risk and commercial outcomes. You will translate enterprise sustainability priorities, supplier inclusion goals and emerging regulatory expectations into practical procurement processes, supplier engagement strategies and reporting controls. Key priorities include supplier decarbonization, supply chain emissions data, ESG supplier due diligence, modern slavery and human rights risk, supplier inclusion, nature-related considerations and category-specific responsible sourcing guidance.

Responsible procurement strategy and governance

Supplier decarbonization, climate data and nature

Partner with Corporate Sustainability on supplier emissions measurement, spend data controls, supplier and category mapping, output validation and supplier decarbonization transition plans.Segment suppliers by emissions impact, sustainability maturity and purchasing category, then design engagement strategies and incentives that support credible decarbonization and embed climate, renewable energy, nature and biodiversity considerations into sourcing activity.

ESG risk, due diligence and regulatory readiness

Strengthen ESG supplier risk management, including modern slavery and human rights risk assessment, ESG screening, escalation, remediation and audit-ready evidence.Work with Legal, Vendor Risk Management and Procurement partners to embed ESG due diligence into vendor screening, sourcing, contracting and ongoing supplier management, while translating relevant regulatory and disclosure developments into scalable controls.

Supplier inclusion and social impact

Lead supplier inclusion initiatives that create practical opportunities for small, diverse-owned, disabled-owned, Indigenous-owned and other underrepresented supplier communities where relevant.Support Bloomberg’s Reconciliation Action Plan (RAP) efforts in Australia, including ongoing engagement with Supply Nation to strengthen Indigenous supplier inclusion.

Data, reporting and technology

 Establish KPIs, dashboards and controls that measure progress, identify risk and opportunity, and support internal governance, annual sustainability, impact and modern slavery reporting.

procurement fundamentals across RFI/RFQ/RFP processes, category strategy, supplier evaluation, negotiation, contracting, vendor management and supplier performance management.Breadth across ESG topics The Senior Manager will build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, develop a deep understanding of their business and talent priorities, and proactively identify workforce risks and opportunities where data, insights, analytics, or digital solutions can improve decision making. The role will translate business strategies into clearly defined questions, hypotheses, and decision needs, then direct the need to the appropriate capabilities across People Insights, Data Science, Data Products, Reporting and Visualization, Employee Listening, and other HR Data & Intelligence teams. The Senior Manager owns stakeholder engagement, problem framing, portfolio alignment, and value realization, while partnering teams retain accountability for technical methodology, product ownership, and solution delivery. The role partners with HR Business Partners, complementing their broader business and talent leadership with specialized workforce intelligence and access to HR Data & Intelligence capabilities.

Success requires a distinctive combination of HR and business acumen, executive consulting, relationship management, strategic thinking, analytical fluency, and storytelling. The Senior Manager will help leaders move beyond data requests toward clear decisions and practical actions, while representing the voice of the business within HR Data & Intelligence. This role offers a unique opportunity to work directly with Johnson & Johnson's most senior HR leaders and influence enterprise workforce and talent priorities.

Strategic Partnership & Executive Advisory

Portfolio Management & Prioritization

Insights Translation & Action Planning

Provide strategic direction for People Insights engagements, helping researchers and analysts connect findings to the business context and intended leadership decisions.Guide and integrate the work of researchers, analysts, and data scientists to ensure complex findings are translated into compelling, balanced, and decision-ready narratives for senior audiences.Facilitate discussions that move stakeholders from insight to decision and from decision to practical, measurable action plans.Shape and oversee the development of executive presentations, strategic recommendations, and workforce stories that connect people outcomes to business priorities.Partner with stakeholders to define success measures, monitor follow-through, and articulate the value and impact of advisory engagements.

Represent HREC, business unit HR, and end-user perspectives across HR Data & Intelligence, ensuring that capabilities remain connected to real business needs.Partner closely with Data Product, Data Science, Reporting and Visualization, and People Insights teams throughout solution design, development, implementation, and adoption.Provide clear feedback and guidance on products and solutions from the business and HR perspective, helping teams preserve analytical intent while improving usability, relevance, and adoption.Identify common and recurring needs across client groups and translate them into enterprise research priorities, reusable solutions, scalable data products, or self-service capabilities.Promote the responsible and appropriate use of workforce data and insights, partnering with relevant experts to support privacy, ethical use, and sound interpretation.

Required

Bloomberg is seeking a Team Leader to lead product management for the real-time news experience across its news product. This role is responsible for alerting, monitoring, and time-critical information delivery, with a focus on speed, relevance, and reliability at scale.

rows.descriptionText:
About CouponFollow

At CouponFollow (NextGen), a System1 company (NYSE: SST), we help over 25 million monthly users save money by connecting them with real, verified coupon codes from thousands of leading retailers. As one of the world’s leading organic coupon sites, CouponFollow.com, we're rapidly expanding our product offerings, user experience, and strategic partnerships.

About The Role

We are looking for a Vice President, Consumer Products & Growth to take end-to-end ownership of our browser extension and related mobile apps business, as well as new strategic growth products in the deals and savings space. This is a hybrid business owner / growth / product-owner role. You'll set the strategy for how we grow these businesses: marketing, installs, retention, and monetization, own the partner relationships that make that growth possible, and work hand-in-hand with product and engineering to ship the roadmap that gets us there. You will be the single point of accountability for the business's performance and growth trajectory.

Responsibilities

 Strategy & Business Ownership 

 Own the extension and related business plans and operating cadence, with accountability for revenue, forecasting, KPI performance, and resource allocation; identify performance gaps early and lead corrective actions across the organization.  Define the growth strategy for the consumer product portfolio, setting the strategic priorities, growth levers, and market-positioning choices that will drive sustainable scale.  Set strategic product direction and roadmap priorities to enhance the product experience and business metrics.  Source and prioritize new business opportunities, evaluating build-vs-partner tradeoffs and sizing potential impact.  Build and scale a high-performing team to drive the business, establishing clear processes, staffing models, and quality standards to maintain strong user experience as volume grows. 

 Performance & Analytics 

 Own performance management of the CouponFollow browser extensions and mobile apps — analyzing, interpreting, and reporting on funnel, acquisition, retention, and cashback performance data.  Establish the reporting cadence and metrics framework the business is run against, surfacing insights and recommendations to leadership. 

 Growth Partnerships & Distribution 

 Own the strategy and execution for performance-based CPA/CPI partnerships that drive installs, activation, and monetization.  Manage the creator/UGC growth function against clear performance targets.  Build and grow high-value partner distribution relationships across affiliate networks, merchants, and other distribution partners, with a clear focus on scalable, pay-for-performance models.  Design, test, and optimize CPA (cost per action) and CPI (cost per install) offers, payout structures, and tracking frameworks to maximize efficient growth and LTV.  Work closely with the partnerships team to align affiliate network and merchant relationships with the extension/app business, ensuring clear KPIs, attribution, and payout accountability.  Define and track partner performance metrics (e.g., eCPI, eCPA, ROAS, retention cohorts) and run regular partner reviews to scale winners and cut underperformers. 

 Compliance & Risk 

 Ensure compliance with tracking technologies, digital marketing standards, and affiliate network stand-down rules.  Collaborate with product, data, and legal to ensure compliant tracking, fraud prevention, and clean integration of partner-sourced traffic into the extension funnel. 

 Cross-functional Execution 

 Manage and develop the paid growth function responsible for day-to-day channel execution - approve budgets, targets, and LTV-based guardrails while holding the team accountable for efficient, scalable growth.  Partner closely with product and engineering to translate strategy into a shipped roadmap.  Act as the connective tissue between partnerships, product, engineering, and leadership to keep the extension business aligned and moving. 

Required Qualifications

 8+ years of relevant experience with responsibility for consumer and product activities (e.g. product growth, product management, GM or P&L owner).  Demonstrated success developing and scaling performance-based growth programs, including CPA/CPI partnerships, affiliate channels, or other pay-for-performance distribution models.  Proven track record building, launching, and maintaining high-scale, successful products.  Experience strategically influencing and aligning senior stakeholders and key partners to consistently drive action, results, and change.  Hands-on, "roll up your sleeves" mindset, with the ability to be a driver and change agent in an organization.  Strong business acumen and data analytics proficiency.  Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, marketing, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 

Nice To Have

 Experience managing app and/or browser extension products.  Experience in affiliate marketing or digital partnerships.  Experience in the shopping and deals space.

Competitive salary + bonus + equityGenerous PTO + 11 company holidaysOpen sick time100% covered Medical, Dental, Vision for employees401k with matchHealth & Dependent Care Flex Spending Account Paid professional developmentLeadership & growth opportunitiesVirtual company and team building events

Job Description

Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine (J&J IM) is seeking an exceptional scientific and organizational leader to serve as Senior Director, Multiomics – Data, Data Science & AI. This leader will oversee our MultiOmics Data Science organization, responsible for harmonizing, integrating, and analyzing multi‑modal Omics datasets across the entire R&D pipeline.

This position has a primary location of Spring House, PA and require up to 25% travel.

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.

Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine

In this role, you will shape the future of how Omics data fuels AI, ML, and computational biology across J&J IM R&D—building reusable, governed pipelines, deploying cutting‑edge architectures, ensuring FAIR data practices, and collaborating deeply with therapeutic area scientists and computational experts for target discovery and disease-biology understanding.

Your organization will drive the cross-functional and shared Omics data lifecycle: from raw data ingestion to standardized, AI‑ready assets to advanced analytical interpretation leveraged across discovery, therapeutic areas, and functions.

The team’s scientific purview includes genomics, transcriptomics, spatial technologies, proteomics, cell atlases, and patient consortia; enabling next‑generation biological insights that accelerate discovery and development programs.

Key Responsibilities

 Strategic Leadership of Global Multiomics Data ScienceDefine and execute the global strategy for Multiomics Data Science across J&J R&D, ensuring data architecture, analysis, and interpretation support scientific and portfolio priorities.Lead a high performing, multidisciplinary team of data scientists, computational biologists, and data engineers.Establish and oversee enterprise-wide standards for Omics data integration, quality, and reuse, leveraging learnings from specialized Omics teams in the Theraputic Areas and Functions to build shared Omics workflows and resources where possible.Drive the effective integration and analysis of largescale human biobanks and cohort datasets (e.g. FinnGen, UK Biobank, Our Future Health, etc.) Enterprise Scale Omics Data AnalysisOversee the establishment and use of reproducible, scalable, Omics pipelines that transform raw data (e.g., transcriptomics, proteomics, etc) into standardized, analysis ready data products for all departments.Champion the use of AI and analytical methods to leverage the wealth of Omics related data the team manages and provide the tools and analytical analyses needed by our Therapeutic Areas and Functions. Multi‑Omics Integration & Cell Atlas DevelopmentDrive innovation in cell atlas construction, including harmonization of single-cell, spatial Omics, proteomics, and genomics datasets.Develop scientific frameworks and analytical methods to assist perturbation response modeling, disease pathway mapping, patient stratification, and target discovery. Analytical Excellence & Cross R&D PartnershipLead advanced data analysis efforts spanning genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, and multi‑modal integration across therapeutic areas.Collaborate closely with AI/ML teams to deliver AI enabled Omics analyses. This includes AI ready data products exposed through APIs and MCP endpoints for AI co-scientists, supporting virtual cell and multimodal foundation models, causal inference, target identification, and enabling risk predictions used across the drug portfolio.Partner with discovery, safety, RWE, and clinical teams to identify impactful scientific questions and deliver data driven insights. Data Governance, Interoperability & FAIR PrinciplesEnsure Omics data assets meet strict governance, reproducibility, compliance, and interoperability standards.Create frameworks that unify Omics with other preclinical and patient data to generate insights that positively impact our drug portfolio. Organizational Development and External EngagementMentor and develop global talent; foster a culture of scientific excellence, transparency, and innovation.Represent J&J Innovative Medicine in key scientific consortia, academic collaborations, and industry forums on Multiomics and data science.

Qualifications

Required

Ph.D. in Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Genomics, Systems Biology, Data Science, or related field.12+ years of experience in Omics data science within pharma, biotech, or leading research organizations, including 7+ years building and leading scientific or technical teams.Demonstrated expertise in multiomics data integration (e.g., genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics), workflows, assisting target identification efforts, and improving our understanding of disease biology through Multiomics analyses.Deep experience designing largescale data systems, pipelines, and AI ready datasets.Strong knowledge of modern computational ecosystems: Python, R, NextFlow workflow and usage, metadata/ontology frameworks, and data governance best practices.Proven track record advising and influencing senior R&D stakeholders to translate complex data science opportunities into strategic scientific impact.

Preferred

Experience with vector embeddings, semantic search, knowledge graphs, or next generation representation learning relevant to Multiomics data.Familiarity with clinical data standards (e.g., FHIR, OMOP, CDISC) and regulatory expectations for scientific data.Contributions in leading roles to major cell atlas, genomics, or proteomics consortia.

Why This Role Is Unique

This is a rare opportunity to lead one of the most ambitious Multiomics Data Science organizations, shaping how Omics data powers next generation therapies in the largest biomedical company in the world. Your work will directly accelerate Johnson & Johnson’s scientific discovery, fuel AI innovation, and impact patients globally.

This organization builds and operationalizes enterprise-scale data, analytics, and AI capabilities that do more than inform decisions—they reshape how HR plans, predicts, personalizes, and performs. By unifying data science, employee listening, knowledge management, and responsible AI, HR Data & Intelligence is transforming workforce signals into strategic advantage, ensuring HR is not only insight-led and future-ready, but a trusted steward of ethical, human-centered intelligence at scale.

The Senior Director, Head of Data Science Services is the enterprise authority for workforce data science and intelligence—setting the vision, standards, and impact agenda for how advanced analytics and AI power HR across Johnson & Johnson. As the most senior leader accountable for data science services, this role drives the end-to-end conversion of global workforce signals—structured, unstructured, and experiential—into predictive insight, scalable models, and decision intelligence embedded directly into HR products, platforms, and moments that matter.

The Senior Director, Head of Data Science Services does not simply deliver analytics; they industrialize insight. They establish a durable, trusted, and responsible data science capability that anticipates workforce needs, unlocks automation and personalization at scale, and elevates HR from a consumer of data to a producer of enterprise intelligence. What’s the role? 

Bloomberg’s Chief Risk Office (CRO) plays a critical role in supporting our businesses and operations globally. We partner across the firm to identify, assess, and manage risks inherent in delivering world-class financial data, analytics, and news.

The CRO Data Risk Program is responsible for ensuring enterprise data is appropriately governed, protected, and managed throughout its lifecycle—minimizing risk while enabling trusted and responsible use of data.

This role will be instrumental in building and scaling Bloomberg’s enterprise data risk management capabilities. You will initially operate in a hybrid capacity across first and second lines of defense, partnering closely with engineering, data, and product teams to establish foundational data governance capabilities. As the program matures, the role will transition toward a dedicated second line of defense function, focused on governance, oversight, and independent challenge.

The CRO Data Risk team provides enterprise oversight across key capabilities including Data Inventory, Data Classification, Data Discovery, Metadata Management, and Data Lineage.

Deloitte’s assurance offerings help those charged with governance to understand their business and build trust amongst key stakeholders and regulators.

We are a multi-disciplinary team of specialists with expertise in risk and controls, regulatory compliance, and audit & assurance. We work with major digital platforms to help them build trust in online safety, transparency and regulatory compliance.Our team plays a critical role to provide regulators, businesses and the public with greater confidence that platforms are meeting their obligations and addressing weaknesses where improvement is needed.
Connect to your career at Deloitte Deloitte drives progress. Using our vast range of expertise, we help our clients' become leaders wherever they choose to compete. To do this, we invest in outstanding people.
